title: Plenty of action and laughs
author: Rob1331
body: I wasn't sure what to expect going into The Brothers Sun but it has everything you want in a good action comedy. Plenty of action, laughs, drama, etc. Outside of Michelle Yeoh, it's made up of a cast of mostly unknowns that are not familiar in America. That should change after this series. Most of them should move on to bigger things here after their job in this. This is just a beautifully acted and written show. I was hooked from the first episode to the last. I was so hooked that I ended up binging all eight episodes as fast as possible. This show knows exactly what it wants to be and doesn't stray and add needless filler just to get to 8 episodes. It's addicting from start to finish. I would not be surprised in the least if this show ends up winning some awards. It's that good.

title: Just a really fun show
author: Supermanfan-13
body: The Brothers Sun was better than I thought it would be. The story is about an eldest son of a Taiwanese triad who returns home to Los Angeles after his father is shot. He returns to protect his mother and brother, who has no idea that the family is in the gangster business. It really is a fun watch with a talented cast who all do a great job pulling you into their world. It seems that Michelle Yeoh can do absolutely no wrong. Everything she's in these days is pure gold. This is her first role since winning an Oscar for best actress in Everything Everywhere All at Once and I think she's even better in this. I would like to see another season of this.

title: FINALLY Netflix Got It Right!!!
author: anoran108
body: After a series of mediocre shows, Netflix nailed it with this one. I was one of the few that enjoyed Cowboy Bebop and was disappointed that Netflix caved into fan boy pressure and dumped it. Cowboy Bebop was flawed but it was a high energy, fun sci-fi romp. I've only watched 2 episodes but I'm a big fan. Don't even get me started when they dumped Sense8. Michelle Yeoh elevates everything just by being in it and so far, so good. The supporting cast is solid, the fight scenes are fun and the goofiness factor is spot on. It's a great show to get lost in and not overthink. I hope they renew for a second season. If Netflix produces more original series like this, I'm in it for the long haul!

title: Great show
author: Plazeebo
body: I hate when they mix comedy with action. It is very rarely done great. But this is actually not that bad on occasion, when it's not done by the comedy-plants. Like when the action guy cleans up the action woman's appartment, or when Michelle Yeoh does a "I'm not locked in here with you, you're locked in here with me" scene.I found it brave of Netflix in this age of diversity to only have Asian actors. When I want to use my brain, I read a book.Easy to understand story, great action and fight choreography. Occasionally great humor - better than most comedy shows these days anyway.What's not to like. This is, for now, the best show on Netflix this year.

title: Bruce is the realest
author: hazard111
body: I went into this show for Michelle Yeoh. I stayed for the Sun family. I had read some reviews in between so I was prepared to dislike Bruce but surprisingly I could understand him. He's basically the odd man out and he's barely surviving but one thing to note here is the central theme of "Protecting your family". He is real with how he reacts because who wouldn't? Honestly I would've been more annoying especially if my family is just determined to shelter me so what else can you do but focus on your life? He's dopey but makes it up with his determination to protect his family. As Michelle said about her son. He's not weak he's just a good person.We get one pov from Charles the older brother, the experienced one vs the sheltered younger brother and they both clash. I like that dynamic of like big guy with the small guy trope. Where in the big guy isn't only a badass but also a big softie and the small guy isn't there to be protected but can kick ass too. Add to that family bonding. I loved the development between them made me wish to also have an older brother. I honestly feel so bad for Charles. His character is by far my favorite and hopefully if this gets renewed we get to see more development of his "real" personality.The show is a mix of action comedy. It doesn't really take itself that seriously. I do wish the action has little bit more... bite? It also got slow early on but picks up again come episode 5. Overall a good binge, nothing too heavy. Just some light family action drama.

title: Great TV!
author: wildgreencat
body: This show borrows from the themes any fan of 90s Jackie Chan movies or even Chinese movies from Hong Kong- a little funny, tongue in cheek, violent emotional romance. Well written and choreographed, I enjoyed all the references and carefully signposted references to living life- Asian. From demanding parents, to cut throat women who use both brain and brawn to get what they want, to sons trying to find their way through societal expectations and stereotypes... All delivered in humourous witty dialogues. Very entertaining and ofcourse it requires some suspension of belief in it's story line and thank God that's the case. Who needs reality in a world such as ours!

title: Great series throughout
author: burntoutboy
body:
I started watching this mainly because Michelle Yeoh was in it. I've only watched 2 episodes so far and she's not been in it much however it has been a blast!Great fighting sequences, good acting and surprisingly funny. The 2nd episode caught me off guard with it's funny and unique fighting sequences.The chemistry between the 2 main actors is promising and hopefully gets to grow throughout the series.The story is ok so far, a little hard to follow but I'm sure it will be explained better the more episodes I watch.Will update my review once I've finished the series but from what I've seen so far, this is a surprise hit for me.Update: this is a great series with great twists, action, acting and comedy throughout (all be it stereotypical, it works most of the time)
Here's hoping for a season 2!

title: Not a 6 or an 8
author: TheWordYo
body:
6.5
There's so many positives from this show. Michelle is class as always. Action scenes are dope, seen someone kicking off about them, they really missed out on some quality 80s movies.Score is pretty slick too and there is some funny bits.Now the really silly things are the brother Bruce, like for real NO ONE behaves that way.Not sure if it was due to the strike why the story is so up and down. If Bruce didn't suck so much and some of the story being so predictable a much higher rating would be justified, I'd love to see more in the future but really dial back the lamé characters cause in this world they just ruin what could be epic.

title: Shakespearean Like Show
author: lakings97
body: The Brothers Sun is a Netflix series created by Barron Wu and Brad Falchuk who also was the person behind Glee and American Horror Story. This is a Shakespearean.style show filled with action fighting sequences much like Jackie Chan along with John Wick killing spree throughout the show. The script follows Charles Sun, a Taipei.gangster's son, who must travel to Los Angeles to protect his brother and his mother after his father is ruthlessly shot and left in a coma. Loved the comedic style of writing and the culinary journey in the San Gabriel area. The wonderful cast is lead by Michelle Yeoh, Justin Chief, Sam Song Li, and Johnny Kou. Overall great first season, wonderful funny script and it was great to see my old school grounds of Woodbury University. Definitely add this to your list.

title: Smart, engaging and stylistic
author: tjerneskog
body: An outstanding cast, led by the ever-evolving Michelle Yeoh who again shows us a truly amazing range of acting. The writing is crisp, leans into the violence Leitch-like and does a really good job of melding culture through old movies and styles, with a more modern approach to action.The underlying conflict of what is evil and bad, is constantly there in the dialogue, and as a viewer you get sucked into the family drama, while you're still asked to take a step back and understand the impact overall. There could have been more of this though, and further explorations of the macro universe would have done more to establish the contrasts.Overall, this is an absolute fantastic ride from start to finish, and the whole cast works as we move from flying severed heads, to cheap cultural jokes and all the way to the classical dramas of family, love and loss.

title: Close to perfect
author: bjornrhein
body: Finally a good serie on Netflix, almost giving up that one, and what a show - I dont want this to end , I could see this like every day in 100 years, usually I dont like action comedy, but here it works toghetter in harmony , I really enjoyed the dry humor in this serie, it was smart and not to much and all the time like similar movies often areIts not perfect , And the negative reviews are not wrong when they complain on the fighting scenes , its just on schoolplay level sometimes , it strange they did not made that better, but probably money issue , also they should cut out the love story and less this Bruce character who is the weak link, and last episode was just flat , so this could have been much sharperBut its forgiven, I had a great time and could easy start to watch it all over again now ,, great serie, loved it.

title: A Disappointing Series with a Weak Link - Bruce
author: tvboxng
body: The Brothers Sun is a new series that has recently hit our screens, and while it has its moments, it ultimately falls short of expectations. The main issue lies in one of the main characters, Bruce, who single-handedly ruins the series with his lacklustre performance and weak character development and unrealistically annoying twists.In the series, Bruce is a character who makes annoying decisions that don't seem realistic towards the end of the series. This not only makes it difficult to connect with him as a character but also takes away from the overall enjoyment of the show.One of the main problems with Bruce is that his character arc is not well-developed. He is a one-dimensional character who lacks any real depth or complexity. This makes it hard to understand his motivations and makes his actions seem contrived and unrealistic.Another issue with Bruce is that he makes decisions that don't seem to make sense. For example, towards the end of the series, he makes a decision that puts his family in danger, and it feels like it was done for the sake of the plot rather than being a natural progression of his character. This makes it hard to take the series seriously and takes away from the overall enjoyment of the show.The series also suffers from poor pacing and a lack of direction. It seems like the writers are unsure of where they want to take the story, and as a result, the series feels disjointed and confusing. This is particularly evident in the way that Bruce's character is handled. He is given very little to do but whine and whine and play dumb the entire series, and his actions often feel forced and contrived.In conclusion, The Brothers Sun is a cool idea for a series that is let down by a weak link - Bruce. His one-dimensional character and lack of development plus an unrealistic annoying behaviour make it hard to connect with him or to care about his journey and quite literally leave a bad taste in the mouth. The series also suffers from poor pacing and a lack of direction, which only adds to the frustration of watching it. If you're looking for a new series to watch just to pass time then go for it but by episode 7 I gave up as it became unbearable.

title: Loved it!
author: isminimccaig
body: It is what you expect and more! Surprisingly funny. Really good acting really good writing. Just enough fighting with realistic choreography. Some shows you know in the first 5 minutes it is going to be good this is one of those shows. Good production they spent money on this and it shows. Characters are not at all one sided and relatable. Subtitles are hard being dyslexic but there isn't too many. Michelle Yeoh is amazing in everything that she does. I love her in this show as a mother. She is delicate and strong at the same time. Watching the dynamic between mother and adult children is very interesting.

title: Mixed experience
author: JellyThyName
body: Too much forced comedy with Bruce's character- he is the weakest part of the show and is central to it. Bruce is just a fool- the best part was him getting a minor beatdown. The action sequences are decent. The writing is mixed, it's missing something and Bruce is probably the one who drags the show down. Charles and Yeoh are the stars of this show, if there was less comedy this show would have probably faired better allowing higher stakes and more intense moments. The foundations are there, but it's missing something- if it was more serious it would have probably been a better show, seems like there were shades of everything everywhere all at once which does not belong in a show about triads.

title: Full Of Fun and Enjoyment
author: Twi12
body: Wow what a great start from netflix in 2024 year. The Brothers Sun might be the best show of the year and the year just started, That's how FANTASTIC it is. This series was fun and had very enjoyable ride. It have great cast Michelle Yeoh and Justin Chien were a pleasure to watch on screen. The show had Incredible emotional, and it managed to compound drama with comedy. It was really well written and had a great action, and awesome fight choreography, And the acting was phenomenal, And so bloody hilarious Can't Wait to see what they will do for a season 2.Go watch it ,Totally Recommend to all.

title: Loved it!
author: Mimzzzz
body: Even though I am not into any of Asian shows, but when I saw that Michelle was in it I gave it a shot. Also, I looked the reviews.Must say I am surprised how good was it! First of all, the soundtrack is on point, also, the fighting scenes are very much bealiveable.I found myself laughing while watching every episode.I liked the mix with serious situations and funny dialogues. Sometimes things were a little bit predictable but also there were some twists.I was a bit annoyed with Bruce sometimes, and this girl Alexis. Also, I would give it an 8, but since I think that the end was a little bit rushed, I gave it a decent and strong 7.All in all it is fun, keeps you interesting and I enjoyed it!

title: Fantastic
author: callumdignan
body: Usually write a big long review with all the pro's and con's of whatever I've watched however I won't waste your time here because there are very few con's to be seen.Fantastic acting, fantastic direction, fantastic music, fantastic story, fantastic everything. At times the story can take some what of a stretch in terms of believability however with the tone of this show being a drama/comedy it fits right in and was never an issue for me. It's hilarious at the right times but more importantly it knows when to take a more serious tone. Respect's it's characters but more importantly it respect's its audience.Feels like so long since I've watched a new movie or tv show and genuinely cared about the characters on screen. Plenty of moments where I laughed however that Jurassic Park reference had me in absolute stitches (If you know you know)Thoroughly enjoyed from start to finish and if you're reading this I highly recommend you watch this show. Netflix, if you don't green light a second season I'm hiring Charles Sun and sending him to your head office.

title: The Brothers Sun - 6/10 - Could Have Been So Much Better
author: williegannon
body: The Brothers Sun could have been so much more. It starts out with a lot of promise. The first four episodes are very good. A nice mix of action and some comedy. The problems start once family dynamics enter the mix.Then the show just can't decide on what it wants to be and the last four episodes are an uneven mix of action, badly placed comedy and either over acted or misplaced drama. The main characters sway between the lines given but even they can't save some scenes.Hardly the most original of stories, and the premise was really good until it wasn't. Probably enough here for a Season 2, but it will need to improve significantly to get a Season 3.

title: Pure fun with a killer soundtrack
author: luccaroma
body: The show was the perfect balance of some really heartbreaking moments coupled with hilarious moments, fantastics twists, and great tense drama. To me, it really has it all.Michelle Yeoh needs no introduction. She is simply unmatched.Justin Chien as Charles. Wow, what a guy. Super acting and my God is he handsome!Whilst I found Bruce annoying he was well acted by Sam Li. Highdee Kuan, Alice Hewkin, and Madison Hu were notably amazing.The soundtrack by Nick Lee and Nathan Matthew David is fantastic and exactly my taste. So much so, that when I went to Spotify to find the show's playlist, lots of the songs I had already in my own playlists - fantastic!

title: This was good, but....
author: marymcfarland-01866
body: It took this series awhile to get where it was going. And whatever point they were trying to make was ultimately unclear. That said, I definitely liked it. But, I didn't know how much I was going to like it until the 5th or 6th episode...that is a lot of episodes to get to the point. Thus, the 6 rating.Overall, it's an enjoyable enough watch. I hope if this gets a 2nd season, we see a bit more of Michelle Yeoh being a total boss. Kind of don't care if we ever see Bruce again, which is unfortunate because it seems like he's supposed to be the center of the show. If he stays, his character needs to be stronger somehow. The way he was written.... I think I got where they were going, but I did not care for the long frickin road they took to get him there.At any rate, it's a pretty good watch.

title: Captivating Crime Drama: The Brothers Sun Strikes a Perfect 9/10 Balance with Engaging Characters and Cultural Depth!
author: simisanni
body: The Brothers Sun deserves a solid 9/10! From engaging characters like Charles, his mom, and June to a captivating blend of action, comedy, and family drama, this show held my attention throughout. The actor portraying Charles is exceptional, and I'm surprised I haven't seen more of his work. What sets this series apart is its unique exploration of criminals questioning their motives, coupled with creative and engaging fight scenes using everyday objects.The show's predominantly Asian cast and cultural themes add depth, highlighting values like respect, family, and filial piety. It's a refreshing take on organized crime that draws parallels to real-life struggles. The absence of other races in certain interactions contributes to the cultural richness of the narrative. Here's hoping for a second season to further delve into this intriguing world!

title: Recast Bruce and I'd give it a 7.5 out of 10
author: diggs-52742
body: Starts off with a pop and a good hook, but struggles with it's own identity as a series, mostly with Bruce's story arc and how poorly his acting dulls the possible funny moments and absolutely cannot take seriously in the somber moments.Also feels a little like a cultural banner film noir, which it doesn't need to be if it's story telling is realistic and the culture is naturally presented as the story naturally progresses. Probably doesn't need to be said, and seems like shades of xenophobic rhetoric, but it's something that writers of these series, or anything, should be aware of in my tiny opinion.Good production, mostly decent acting and good balance of humor and action. Recommended watch if you're bored.

title: Good action story with one extremely stupid character.
author: maneetmusic
body: A very well made series when it comes to action sequences and a good plot. The Taiwanese gangster family drama with honour and obligations that spills over to America, adds freshness to the Netflix range.Michelle Yeoh adds class to a decent cast. In fact, she soars above the rest as a Triad member in hiding, an over protective Mom, a lady that's yards ahead of everyone with her wits.But in Bruce Sun, they probably made the stupidest, most idiotic, most exasperating character in the history of Netflix series.They were probably trying to go for a Jackie Chan style bumbling, funny but good hearted character. But they ended up making a cowardly, unreliable, disloyal, extremely stupid character.You never feel sorry for him, never connect with him or even empathise with him. I wonder why Sam Song Li didn't ask the script writers to do better.Since Bruce is so central to the story, the presence of this character 'almost' single handedly spoils an otherwise brilliant plot and a well constructed storyline.'Almost' being the operative word. But the story, Michelle Yeoh, Justin Chein, the action sequences, the Taiwanese American flavour; rescue the series.

title: First episodes were good though
author: Svatos40
body: While the pilot was good, entertaining and promising, episode after episode, it's getting worse. The writing and story is just awful. The fighting scenes are bad aswell. I actually can't believe I watched the entire season, but my girlfriend wanted to see it all. What a waste of time. I'm just rating this a 4/10 because the first episodes were good. Looking at the "amazing reviews" here, it's pretty obvious these reviews are bought. There's no way people rate this series higher than 5-6/10. Just no way at all. If you're looking for an amazing series with great fighting scenes and a way better storyline, check out "Warrior".

title: You will binge this...
author: ty-11850
body: Given the opportunity, it's just natural. This series is done very well. Very subtle twist turns surprises humor, action violence it's in sync. I watched the first episode and a half or something and had to go to work. Came home and immediately finished the season. It's just a feel good watch Actually wrote this before the last episode started. I'm just confident it's gonna finish promisingly lol. But it literally does have everything. It's a bit of romance, some great humor, good character development, excellent fight scenes choreography was amazing. And I am currently rooting for way more characters than is feasible for this to work out in one universe...

title: Michele Yeoh and Justin rock this series but others are lacking
author: annumarch
body: If the character of the younger brother was slightly mature or even if he grew with the series would have been nice. Even towards the end he was saying some things but his actions didn't reflect the seriousness of the situation.The filmography is great till the end and pace is engaging, you don't want to disengage in the middle. I could finish the series in two days.There are cliches littered all along the storyline but the execution and acting makes it the worthwhile. This isn't something you would maybe recommend to friends but if need something to watch while munching food this is a good choice.

title: For the family
author: gqdmdg
body: Was reminded quite often of the Fast and Furious franchise due to the repeated mention of "family." Being a fellow Asian, I can chime with the importance that is placed on family in eastern culture. The action sequences are fun, and what really drew me into the the show. It was sorta like Taiwanese John Wick with over the top action sequences. The show drags in the middle for a bit ( maybe I felt that due to the fact that I binged a good portion of it). The ending is sweet. The acting performances are above average, with the exception of Michelle Yeoh and Charles Sun (cba yo look up his real name atm).In the words of Jeremy Jahns: "Good time, but maybe some alcohol would make it better"

title: Entertaining enough
author: hydralien
body: It's a decent TV show, good actors, decent story, some funny moments and some nice fighting scenes. It's always pleasant to see Michelle Yeoh, though not in much action this time, and other actors are doing good job too - apart from perhaps the one that plays the youngest son, or perhaps the role is written that way, but it's mostly annoying to watch. Not too much though.It's entertaining enough, and was not entirely unappealing, and had its moments. My problem with it is it lacked much meaning to it, or much conclusion - there's season 2 likely coming, but that promise wasn't that promising.Decent watch, still.

title: The Brothers Sun
author: valdezisabelle-46669
body: The show is fast, paced and funny (and a little gruesome ) and has a lot of action The fight scenes are fun & well choreographed but Bruce!! Bruce is so annoying. I cannot stand him and his character is ruining the show. He's so inept and he never ever ever ever gets better. He's pathetic. Alexis is a pretty annoying unlikable character as well . Michelle Yeoh & Justin Chien are fantastic ! Worth watching for them. The other actors are all good and the show is cast well .I like the setting in LA & Taiwan too All in all , the show is worth watching If the Bruce character wasn't so unbelievably annoying I could rate the show higher.

title: they should have promote this show more
author: danyfs12
body: One of the best action TV series to ever hit streaming! Within the first 5 minutes, you are hooked and immediately on the edge of your seat for the rest of the series. Honestly its a stellar cast, you felt the stakes were high. The pacing of the show was perfect, even the 'filler' moments felt like it was meaningful in terms of establishing backstory and inter-character relationships. Can easily binge this in a day without stopping. Michelle Yeoh is just incredible in everything that she does, but she nailed her role as the caring mother. HIGHLY RECOMMEND, this could be action/TV series of the year.

title: A fantastic start to 2024!
author: MessMaker
body: A thoroughly enjoyable combination of action, comedy and drama. It is super stylish, has vibey music choices and is paced perfectly for what it's going for.The storyline is evolving all the time and is not predictable whatsoever, which makes it very engaging. There's depth and meaning, many themes, development of characters, mysteries & revelation, turns & twists & then some, conflict - it was pleasantly surprising how it managed to do all that organically and kept it engaging all the way.Every character is written so well from introduction to where they end up. And the cultural elements are incorporated so authentically & realistically that it's strange to believe I'm watching something like this in the west (like "Beef" last year, but this is specific to Taiwanese and I liked it more). Impressive output from the actors, too, they absolutely nailed their work - charismatic & captivating!Despite having depth & darkness to it, it's such an easy, addictive & fun watch that I binged it all in one evening!"The Brothers Sun" achieves exactly what it's going for and the way it's doing it is beyond just entertainment! Hope they earn some nominations and win some awards :)

title: The Brother Sun BETTER than expected!
author: mauiloves
body: Very much enjoyed accidentally coming across The Brothers Sun. It is filled with EVERYTHING that makes these series GREAT (and not many are). It's funny, filled with kung-fu action, a hilarious plot and just overall delightful. So, imagine how NOT surprised I was to read that Netflix isn't picking up a 2nd season! Not sure if this is NORMAL because it seems EVERY RATE GOOD SERIES BY NETFLIX will inexplicably be terminated! And, to the dismay of so many of us that enjoyed it so much, F. U.!Netflix you make no damn sense! Keep that which SUCKS and cancel that which members enjoy. I can honestly say, renewing is likely NOT gonna happen since NOTHING GOOD last.

title: Could be better, not 'Warrior', but has potential.
author: theedeer
body: Some good actors but the attempts at comedy are not that good. The series could do well if they allow the actors to make it more serious acting/scripting and go from there. I really want to like this and am giving it the 7 instead of a 6 because most of the actors could excel with less meaningless poorly developed comedy and better serious plot. I will change the rating depending on if they get to a 2nd season and correct the portions that keep them at risk of non-renewal. I would recommend watching Warrior, as it has all the right elements to make a really great similar show. Warrior needs better air time/slot and advertising, but is tremendous & could be well learned from... maybe even hire some of the people from the series to help.

title: They canceled it, so Netflix screws up again
author: unnamedandu-17527
body: I gotta say, this was a very good tv show done in such a sea of bad choices for the Netflix tv shows.For me this show was better by the episode, it did mis here and there but it kept me entertained and willing for more. After watching and wishing for more I wind up finding that Netflix canceled renewing it for the second season.This being said, I also have to warn everybody else that this is good but go on knowing that it ends in a way that it doesn't feel totally complete. It rushed its last minutes just so it might end like a limited run.Maybe it's just me feeling disappointed.Anyhow, I think it's a GOOD show so I'll give it an 8!

title: Surprisingly Good
author: lucky-71416
body: Going in, I had very low expectations for this show.Based on the first trailer, The Brothers Sun looked like it was following the path of other bland Netflix shows, featuring bad writing, poor acting, and a rushed production. However, after watching 2 episodes, I was pleasantly surprised.The comedic elements in the show are genuinely funny and the acting is pretty good. I found the quirks that many of the show's characters have very charming and really enjoyed the dynamic between the two brothers. In just a few episodes, The Brothers Sun somehow managed to make me care about its characters and get invested in the plot, which is something few shows are able to do nowadays.Michelle Yeoh's performance is wonderful as always, but I was most impressed by the actor who plays Bruce as he does a great job handling the comedic and serious moments of the show. The actor who plays Charles also plays the comedy very well, though I found his acting in the more emotional and serious scenes a bit one-note and lacking some nuance.If you like action, this show also features several well-choreographed and creative fight scenes.I've seen a few criticisms directed at the show's stereotypical depiction of Asians and Chinese culture, which I do agree with, but I think it works with the show's comedic tone. The show's humour makes it obvious to the viewer that these characters are not meant to be taken seriously and that the cultural aspects the show includes are played up for laughs, and not meant to be realism.Personally, my only issue with the show begins somewhere in the last 2 episodes as some of the choices the character Bruce makes make absolutely no sense and completely contradict his previous actions, resulting in a rather convoluted excuse to force Bruce to go after his family. The choice Charles ultimately makes at the very end of the series also makes the conclusion feel unsatisfying as the show feels like its building up to a different choice, though I understand this is to set up the possibility for a second season.Overall, I really enjoyed it and I hope Netflix renews it for a second season! Would love to see where else the story goes.I highly recommend the watch!

title: In the middle.
author: Otte1
body: It is very hard to combine murder/comedy and to do it successfully. Because of the comedy overtones, you cannot take the fight scenes seriously so it is hard to get invested or care to have any tension in the scene.The comedy could work if.......it is funny. But the director is focusing on the wrong comedy part. The scene of the brothers being scared to tell Mom they were attacked by killers is funny when they get home and they see that their Mom is more gangster then they are. That's funny! But instead they focus on a overly cliched bumbling fool who belongs in a 3-minute SNL skit, not a multi-hour movie series. He is never funny, just stupid, and the actor does nothing to make the character sympathetic. Most of the time you are wishing someone will kill him.I give credit to having some action in each episodes, but it felt like cotton candy, okay the first time, but the second or third time you throw it away in the trash.

title: Best Comedy Action in a LONG TIME
author: ryantgray-53572
body: I gave it a ten by grading it on the curve. If it came out 10 years ago, I'd probably give it an 8, but compared to a lot of swings and misses over the past decade, especially the last 5 years, this is amazing!First, the action is very fun and just realistic enough to not feel like another super hero extravaganza.The comedy is subtle, sharp and A political, poking fun at Asian, American and Southern Californians (Coming from California, I especially appreciate that) making the humor feel classy.The Characters are fleshed out a little bit more as the story unfolds, giving way to a deepening story lineThe directing and editing are a breath of fresh air.The shooting and story-telling is a nod to American-Asian Culture. What's really impressive is that the editing is sharp, like the older action shows, back before Netflix when every minute was a premium. The editor shows a respect for the viewers time.The director has a fantastic sense of flow, moving seamlessly from family conflict, awkward comedy, to sensational fight scenes with a hint of mystery/cop drama thrown in for good measure.If you liked John wick, any of the older John woo or even early Guy Richie, you will really enjoy this breath of fresh air....even if with it's occasional wisp of blood.There is some R type violence and language, but through 6 episodes, the nudity and sexual content is very minimal, Which is also a nice change of pace, and I appreciate.

title: Great Show!
author: bobzzzz
body: Right from the start - great show. It's funny most of the time, and seriously action-packed at other times. The entire cast of actors knocks it out of the park. The character development is phenominal - I could feel a little heartbreak whenever one of them was killed, even the bad guys. Maybe that's why this series is so wonderful, the writers took the time to tell the story from different angles and let people judge for themselves about who to choose and why the gangsters did the things they did.Ii seemed like there may not be a season 2, until the last scene of the shows, after the credits rolled. I think there will be, so see you then.

title: The Brothers Fun!!
author: rodgersjacob-77234
body: Do you like luxury vehicles, fancy California homes, deeply troubled family drama? What about churros or even the Great British Bake Off? If any of these things tickle your fancy then The Brothers Sun is definitely for you.Overall I gave the rating for this show an 8. Was it enjoyable, absolutely. Was it at times overly predictable, unfortunately yes. Would I find my self wanting to watch this again, probably not. Would I be excited for a season 2 announcement, you bet!What I enjoyed the most was that the main character Bruce provides the show with a unique sense of comedic relief I have not seen in many characters as of recent. Getting to see his character portrayed again would make me smile. I also thought the character development in Charles was done nicely. Visuals weren't to bad themselves either, with plenty of action packed, well choreographed, fight scenes.

title: No sense
author: rich-12169
body: Ok..So im guessing im not supposed to be trying to think more into anything that is happening. Just let all the plot holes continue then? Well...Thats hard for me to do. From the super big to the super small. Nothing in this world makes any sense.First of all, in what college do you get -20 points for turning in a test early? That makes no sense. I could really talk about this one all day but lets move on.The asian guy kills 3 people then his father comes in and basically explains the situation so that it is completely obvious that it was all for him, and yet as he is explaining this, he does not realize it? I..dunno. ITs just super obvious he is about to get shot..and he does.The young asian boss eats a churro and it leads us to believe he has never had anything sweet before,,even though he was making 2 cakes in the last scene. Now suddenly he is hooked on churros like they are gods gift on earth. When he makes elaborate cakes...ok, no sense.So blah blah blah plot hole plot hole plot hole...The mom is clearly the one setting all this up. Or its a test from the father. ITs something stupid like that...but ill never finish it because its just not entertaining enough.

title: More asian stereotype heavy series
author: AsianTalentHollywood
body: Let's get this out of the way. Stop, please stop with stereotype Asian series! Chinese gangs, fight fight fight, and to cover all the bases, add in a younger brother who is the perfect nerdy Asian stereotype. As far as the series goes, we've seen this too many times and there is nothing new or original. Justin Chien is good as the older brother, but Sam Li really doesn't seem to get what project he's in because the comedy he's providing belongs somewhere else. He's not playing "clueless" to the family business, he's just playing bad, nerdy humor. Luckily Michelle Yeoh holds things together, but not enough to make this anything more than something good enough to watch if you can't find anything better. Back to my original thought, stop, please stop with the stereotype Asian series and give us something more original.

title: Xie xie
author: jvormer
body: Holly hell, did the brothers Wu deliver on this promise. The show peeked my interest with the trailer. I mean Michelle Yeoh as the head of a major crime family is a no brainer.The show has brilliant timing with its jokes, action and story. One never gets in the way the other and that balance is hardly seen these days, with over 85% of all streaming shows being mere garbage.Somehow this shows pulls it of to combine, the 'drunken master" jokes with the "crouching tiger hidden dragon" action while writing a love letter to Chinese heritage.All the actors are well on point. Sam Li pulls of the most difficult jokes with his timing and finesse. While Justin Chien is that Triad you don't want to mess with. To top it all of Michelle Yeoh is the Don, the beauty of it all no one doubts she could be the head of a major crime family.The Wu brothers did and outstanding job to create the perfect crime family that we all root for!

title: Strong start that progressively fizzles out
author: slowpulse
body: Overall it's an entertaining and watchable product. The well-coreographed ass kicking alone makes it worth a look, but the strong start is not matched by later episodes that get successively more bogged down in family theatricals and sermons about traditions and blood. All the while, we're essentially asked to root for people who are Asian mafia elite, who've accordingly based their whole lives on the ruthless exploitation of other human beings. For that to happen, we need charismatic and playful characters, but I personally couldn't quite find it in my heart to cheer for these ones all that much.There's also a very weak love story buried in here that really stretches believability, but fortunately it doesn't take up too much running time. All in all, there was enough production value and dedication put in this to make it worthwhile, but it's probably a good idea to limit it to one season.

title: This show is great
author: chriskunk
body: Amazing show. Anyone who says otherwise is trash. It's funny, the action is good, and the actors are great. People try way to hard to give bad reviews to great things because they hate everyone. Are there some plot holes, bad scenes and stupid moments ? Sure there is but it's a comedy drama not an Oscar movie. You won't be disappointed watching this.It's not your typical show, Keep that in mind. It kind of reminds me as a triad themed Psych with more fighting. Mostly a comedy surrounded by action and the occasional tense scenes. But comedy, character silliness, friend and parent relationships all are similar. Very few comedy drama action shows do it like these two.

title: What Shang Chi should have been
author: ijchhoa
body: Competently acted, well written and most importantly, feels like a true crossover between two cultural worlds.In its limited run, the show takes on the questions of tradition vs freedom, individual vs familial identity, and a big splash of moral ambiguity, while never letting these supercede the core of an engaging mafia drama. The American expy starts off individualistic and ends up finding meaning in family. The Chinese expy starts off devoted and ends up finding a healthier balance without completely "converting"/losing who he is. There is equal respect for the dyed-in-the-wool Chinese perspective, and the show is willing and even happy to sit with the complexity that emerged when the two clash and mix, instead of resolving it in dumb patricide (looking at you Shang Chi). I am satisfied without a season 2 and would happily watch if there was one.

title: Movie was disappointing because Bruce character
author: brizzle-43039
body: The show was actually one of the best shows I've seen about gangs or drugs since Narcos, but because of the character, Bruce, and how he was raised to be such a little girl the ending did not meet my expectations and overall ruined it for me. If only his character hadn't of done some things towards the end of the series, I would have liked this series a lot more, and it wouldn't have left such a bad taste in my mouth for all of the triad leaders, except for a few not only to get murdered or arrested because of the character it would have been a 10 out of 10 for me, but because of him I can only realistically say I wish I hadn't have watched the last two episodes.

title: So fun to watch!
author: marynashevtsova
body: Such a great entertainment! The characters are likeable, the pace is fast. I agree with other reviewers that it is slightly predictable but this is also comforting. I was really rooting for both brothers and their mom and loved for the story developed and the ending the first season got (and I hope we will see at least one season more, please!!!). I am a bit hesitant though about the series romanticising crime and showing killers and drug dealers as nice people with principles as if justifying their behaviour so in this sense maybe another ending would be better but you get what you get within action comedy genre. Also, absolutely great cast and I hope we will see more of them in other Netflix series and beyond!

title: Some solid entertainment for action series fans.
author: BPMKent
body: There's a lot to like about this series. Firstly, it's a good balance of storyline, characters, action and a bit of comedy. It doesn't take itself too seriously, but that doesn't mean there aren't some sad moments in it either.Next, is the good choice of casting. It isn't necessarily a great cast, but there's a good blend of established actors while clearly also proving a good opportunity for some new talent.Lastly, I have to credit the writing and the plot. While kung fu action stories can sometimes struggle to present a good good story, particularly to Western audiences, the way they've embedded some family values marks it out as more than the average martial arts production, with a couple if twists to stop it from becoming stale.That said, there are a few points which I think prevent this from being a classic; some of the twists are pretty predictable, the comedy can skirt around the generic, and the story isn't all that original.However, having watched it through, it's a good but of entertainment which I'd recommend to many people and, importantly, I believe it has re-watch appeal, although maybe not and time soon.

title: Perfection
author: jordanlovemes
body: A perfectly balanced serie... It contains everything you wish you want to see. Some good violence some good plot twists and some love fairytale. Revenge as you expected and the filling that everything make sense. An absolute built of the characters and a character to connect for every different person that whacking this... I am a person that had seen at least 100 series and for me it was at the top 5 so far and this is because it makes you jump from your seat in every second scene. Although if you are into some good drama or a historical movies and serious staff this is not something for you. Choose it if you want to have some good time and something easy for your mind to process.

title: Decent action/comedy mix
author: wnstonn
body: Certainly better than expected, this show presents an original and creative plot that stands out in its genre. The well-crafted blend of action and comedy, bolstered by strong performances from the cast, ensures that viewers remain thoroughly entertained. The actors' excellent performances contribute significantly to making the show enjoyable, to the point that it makes the predictability of certain plot elements almost unnoticeable.However, the finale leaves something to be desired. It felt somewhat disjointed and left several questions unanswered. This unresolved ending hinted at the possibility of a second season to tie up loose ends. Unfortunately, it has been announced that a second season will not be happening. Despite these shortcomings, the show's strengths make it a memorable watch.

title: Average entertainment
author: kaideneve
body: In terms of writing, this series borders on satirical. The script is so unnatural and forced, it's almost comedic, and as a result, I found it hard to take any of the actors seriously. How Kidman and Schreiber got wrangled into this fiasco of a production is a more suspenseful mystery than that on which this entire series is based.That said, it does keep you engaged. I don't regret watching the series, it's a pretty formulaic production, very predictable, and if you're looking for a lazy weekend show to binge, it will scratch that itch. You're not watching Citizen Kane, but what the hey. Sometimes we all just need to turn our brains off for a bit and be entertained.

title: Temu version of "White Lotus"
author: nastiadsaint
body: I was so excited to watch it, the cast looked great, and I love the genre.The views of Nantucket Island are gorgeous. Easy to watch, murder plot is good. But something was missing. Most of the characters were annoying. Particularly I disliked the French lady. I get it that they wanted a corky lady to bring some humor with a European touch, but it didn't work out at all. None of the sons were appealing. Even Live Schreiber was a disappointment. I am so upset with Nichole Kidman for ruining her face. It is very hard to concentrate on her acting without constantly thinking of her morphed face, and I really hate to say it. But her tall and slim body left me in awe! Meghann Fahy (Merritt), on the other hand, is absolutely gorgeous with all her natural wrinkles and freckles. I didn't fall in love with any of characters. I did enjoy the woman detective though. All characters felt flat, even the main "poor" girl. Some scenes were well executed, but some were just awful and awkward (the whole scene with book singing....wth was that? Just so bad!). Such a great potential for the series and somehow, they missed the mark. I would totally recast most of them and bring more darkness and less awkwardness. The ending at the zoo didn't work out for me at all. I would rather it ended with Amelia seeing the new book written by Greer at the airport, she glanced at the dedication page and put it back on shelf, then we see her walking to her gate. And, scene!Still fun to binge watch. If you are bored and have a few hours, go watch it and let me know if you guessed the killer right away.

title: Going for some cheese
author: julieshotmail
body: The casting is perfect, isn't it? You've got Nicole Kidman, the seasoned pro who can carry just about anything. Dakota Fanning, all talent and precision, and then Meghann Fahy, still riding that wave from "White Lotus." Together, they pull in the whodunit crowd, no question. The backdrop? Gorgeous. And that simmering disdain for the filthy rich? Yeah, that hooks you in too, at first.But here's the thing - beneath that glossy surface, it starts to wear thin. The endless closeups, the subplots that vanish without a trace, those misdirections that turn out to be... well, nothing. It's like you're being led around in circles, waiting for something with depth, something that'll hit hard. Instead, you're left with a hollow echo where there should've been a punch.Kidman, Fanning, and Fahy? Sure, they shine. They always do. But the material? It just doesn't rise to their level. By the end, that big reveal you've been waiting for? Yeah, you probably saw it coming from a mile away. And the worst part? You're left thinking it could've been more - should've been more.

title: started slowly ... but...
author: hamlet-16
body:
The critics have been cruel. The ratings are middling BUT they miss the point.This is a typical Agatha Christie-esque who-dunnit.... take a group of people at a country house and have a dead body type of whodunnit.So it becomes a sort of puzzle.1. Attractive cast - check
2. Attractive locale - check
3. Characters with secrets - check
4. Characters with motive - check
5. Characters with opportunity - check
6. Murder victim who may or may not be a nice person - check
7. Big reveal at the end after assorted red herrings are resolved. - checkNow comes the hard part. Is it well done?Actually I think it is. It does drag at little in the middle but the resolution works.As for the cast. I think they all do quite well and Nicole Kidman whom I have never quite taken to actually surprises me. I usually find her cold but in this, at the end, I fully understood her character. Her much maligned accent actually makes sense in the circumstances.Give it a try. It is not the greatest mystery ever but it is fun if you just go along for the ride.

title: Ooh, it's a comedy....
author: louise_strange
body: I would have enjoyed this so much more if it had been labelled a comedy/dark comedy. I've read lots of books with similar plots and have enjoyed them but the tone in this show felt a little off from the start. Good actors were bad, performances were too big, etc. I thought it was just incredibly cheesy for the most part but by the end it's a clearly a full on satire. Keep this in mind and you might actually enjoy it, even if the overall direction doesn't quite get the tone right all the way through.Not good enough that I'd seek out the book it's based on but a decent watch if you're in the mood for a cheesy show that doesn't take itself too seriously (and you can handle some bad accent work).

title: Quirky.
author: ple-may
body: Well, I've seen the reviews of people who criticised this show, but I have to admit - I liked it. It's quirky and different, but most definitely a slow burn. I guess in an age where everything is fast paced that's why so many didn't like it.If you're patient, this is a clever and rewarding ride. It's is well cast, amazingly well acted by some very talented people, and mildly comical in an understated way. It'll keep you guessing almost as much as the police officers trying to crack the case.Give it a go, but pay attention to the characters who are much more fun than the actual plot, and don't expect instant gratification. It's a slow burn for a reason.

title: One-dimensional show struggling with its identity
author: angiesideacc
body: Great cast but I feel like the show was confused with its identity the entire time. Is it a thriller? A classic whodunnit? A dramedy? The suspense was premature at best and the humor felt misplaced. Some scenes also felt out of place, and left me quite confused as to why they were included in the first place. Take the cake scene between the brothers for example - what was the point of that? Slapstick comedy? I doubt anyone laughed. A cute heartfelt moment showing playfulness between brothers? Lacked that emotion. A moment showing disdain, competition, or genuine anger between the brothers? It completely lacked depth.Nicole Kidman is a class act but this show was one-dimensional and not well thought out. Felt almost like a high school project. Just compare it to Big Little Lies and you'll see the stark diffeence.

title: The only mystery here is why it was made
author: ivanunk
body: Terrible plot, zero rhythm, police work so absurd it feels like a parody, and enough soap opera-level twists to make even telenovela writers confused. By the end of this "murder mystery," you're expecting Nicole Kidman to rip off her wig and dramatically reveal she's actually the long-lost brother of the bride's father.By the time the grand finale rolls around and the murderer is revealed, you've stopped caring. So has the police. And the entire family, for that matter. Yet, I'm sure this will be the most-watched series of 2024-because viewers will hang on just to see how much worse it can get.

title: Ignore the bad reviews! It's super fun!
author: wandasvision
body: A lot of hating on here! Not sure what the root of it is. But honestly, I love a good mystery and I got my whole family together just to see Nicole Kidman (since she always does them well!). I was worried because of the awful reviews but it genuinely was really good! I almost didn't want to watch because of the reviews, but please don't let them sway you. It's good!Keeps you guessing until the end and the performances are dramatic whilst also funny. It's a really good time and I would recommend it to anyone.Fun tip: my family and I always watch the first episode of a mystery and write down who we think did it after episode one is up and save it until the series finishes! This is a good one for it with only 6 episodes.Grab a friend and enjoy. Ignore the silly reviews someone's hating on Nicole!

title: Trash entertainment
author: JulianBgl
body: This is the ultimate definition of trash entertainment; watching this show is straightforward six hours of time wasted. The writing is ridiculously bad, the plot is very predictable, and the performances are flat...Overall, is very hard to watch this show, as most of the episodes are plagued with irrelevant details that don't add anything to the main story. The writers really failed in making any of these characters interesting.I'm surprised that actors of the size of Nicole Kidman, Dakota Fanning, and Liev Schreiber decided to take part in this regrettable project of Netflix.Avoid yourself a disappointment and watch something different.

title: oke 'drama' with many problems
author: HLEYE
body: This is a well made series, however, there are problems, Kidman, for one. Can't believe she won an award for baby girl (or anything for that matter) - she's robot like, has no facial expressions left because of surgery, and always does the same thing - whatever that is (being an humanoid i guess). The other problem is Isabelle Adjani, who (also) used to great and beautiful, but had some work done as well and wearing a ridiculous wig. The next problem is the sheer awfulness of almost everyone in this series - or the caricature like performances here and there. The shallowness, the dishonesty, the arrogance etc... well executed though, and one keeps wondering who donnit... however, we couldn't care much about who got killed and were wishing the Walking Dead would invade and kill m all.... so a six for the effort, the filming, and some of the performances - the best was probably the police woman ... and the chief of police maybe.

title: It's...OK
author: davetotherescue85
body: I genuinely struggled through most of it to pay attention. Most of the characters seemed lacking something or just too completely Cliche. Nicole Kidman did an excellent job at playing the stuck up/ up tight rich wife that rules every part of the families life. A lot of people said Liev Schreiber just phoned his performance in but I thought he played his roll extremely well. It boils down to a rich family murder mystery where the cops seem completely incompetent. It's only after politely asking each subject and literally taking their word for it do we FINALLY find out who the killer is, which is barely explained what the motive was.

title: Boring
author: Vadmeggymag
body:
Rich people's hypocrite life. We've seen that more than enough.Boring story, boring actors, except maybe Liev Schreiber. Aging well. Sadly the face of Nicole Kidman is completely motionless, that's boring and a bit creepy. Dakota Fanning is an so overrated actress she have only one face in every situation. Boring. (For Example Kidman has much more once upon a time.)
Eve Hewson absolutely characterless. Booooring. The other guys too.The Perfect Couple story, pictures, characters reminds me of Big Little Lies without its mystery, construction and good acting.But I watch througt it so five stars. Maybe I am hypocrite too.

title: Mediocre Netflix again, again, again....
author: acnovo
body: Perfect cast, acting superb, story "had potential", the execution was very disappointing. Nicole Kidman, and Dakota Fanning are two of the best actresses alive, both fill any scene even without dialogues. "The Perfect Couple" reminds me of the Clue movie from the 80s, the difference here is that it's not funny, it's not drama, it's not mystery... I would blame it on the direction, beyond bad. They tried to make if funny and it was not funny, tried to make it big suspense and it had none. How do bring Isabelle Adjani to such a mediocre production. I'm sorry for all the actors in this Netflix production, feels like a school homework. Baaaaaad.

title: Loved it and binged in one day
author: marite_broka
body: I binged it in one day and absolutely loved it. Some action happening all the time already from beginning. Loved how some characters are build with a bit of exaggeration- it just adds some flavore. I was wondering a bit why so many bad reviews as this was pretty nice murder mistery. As series goes on, you change your suspicions from one character to another. If you liked Big little lies, then I am sure you will like this one too. Actually I found those two shows a bit similar- they both are jumping from presence to the past. Also you can unravel some personality traits as tensions in this house hold grows. So if you are looking for a soft murder mistery, then this is really nice one.

title: It' not bad at all
author: maurilad82
body: So here we are on an island off the east coast.There is a marriage supposed to happen, and then a dead body shows up.I watched it in one seating, No spoilers here.Show is elegant, trying to catch up with the white lotus?All the actors are point on, Nicole Kidman is ok, Schreiber is excellent.The rest of the cast ok, they keep it up. People say it is predictable, well it is not.Now, it isn't Agatha Christie either, but you can just watch it and enjoy.Kidman is gettin used to this kind of shows, and I fully understand she could do much better, BUT her acting is flawless.There are some characters that look a bit dodgy and don't get the development they deserved, but this was a mini series, so in my own opinion, get on with it and enjoy.

title: Again drawn in by top notch actors...
author: indy500-02743
body: Didn't read the book upon which this series is based. In no particular order, Liev, whose performances I enjoy, was devoid of personality or spirit, notwithstanding his 'performance' at the book press event. Kidman 'dancing' along to that was just embarrassing. Was her hairstyle a metaphor for her rigid persona? I didn't even recognize Adjani. She reminded me of Cousin Itt channeling Morticia, with one too may facelifts. And the constant infusion of a French phrase in EVERY line of her dialogue? Lackluster bride-to-be. Her connection to Shooter??? Unfortunately, not enough of the Maid of Honor. She had some personality and beauty, unlike the bride-to-be. Should have been titled MY THREE SPOILED SONS.

title: My first review, because I had to
author: iljamiedema-69955
body: This is the first time I leave a comment, just because I was obsessively checking the reviews for this series until I was able to watch it. Since I saw the announcement I was excited, but when I read the reviews doubts started kicking in (as always)I was looking forward to this show, because The White Lotus (HBO Max) absolutely has my heart. Maybe it's not as good, but I really enjoyed it... Not too long, and a really enjoyable/quick watch. Give it a try I would say! (Don't let negative comments stop you, because I normally do :) For me it didn't disappoint, and I think that's most important if you want to enjoy something!

title: Another Rich People with problems show
author: True_Reviews
body: People love these stories. Rich people with problems so they can feel better about themselves since they are not rich. After all, rich people do not watch shows about rich people with problems, they are too busy making money. The acting is actually good but there are so many holes in the story it had to be written by someone more interested in a story than in fact. I mean, you do not question a suspect in a hospital room with no one else around. It would be coercion, and you would lose any case in court. And like many shows that are written without thinking, the cops are portrayed as idiots who consistently try to intimidate their suspects into giving them answers at every turn. Hello, Hollywood, not every cop is dumb!! But this is not a reality show, more about who done it and who is the murdered. All I can say is the show is too long. Could have been a 2-hour movie and would have made the same sense, maybe more sense.

title: Fun but disappointing
author: idomayraz
body: I love Liev Schreiber but have to say it out loud. The perfect couple feels like a down graded version of the white lotus and it is a shame because the actros are great. Shallow dialogs, implausible script all together wind up into a soap opera feel. Having said that , it is a fun show to watch, the. Nonetheless, the series is fun to watch-the cinematography is beautiful and aesthetically pleasing, and it maintains a certain lightness that allows viewers not to take it too seriously.In conclusion, it could have been a great show to watch -if the narrative would have been more sophisticated and more realistic.

title: Inauthentic fun
author: ericjanik
body: Its easy to see that Elin Hilderbrand, who wrote the book this series is based on, was not in on writing the screenplay. Granted, Nantucket is more New Yorkish than Martha's Vineyard, but this is still Massachusetts. The dialog is more Long Island, or even Palm Beach. I mean, even the most gauche arrivistes know better than to talk about money at a wedding reception. And true Nantuckteers, even summer people, do their best to act like they belong here, which means not putting on airs and treating the police detectives like hired help. Still, like any other Elin Hilderbrand fan, I'm going to keep turning the pages to see what happens next.

title: Loved it
author: thebearandgoat
body: I found it very interesting and definitely enjoyed watching it. I hope there is a season two!I started watching the first episode and ended up watching all six.I thought the characters were great and very interesting.I recommended it to a friend and she seems to be enjoying it as well.It was a good story, lots of action, and a great mystery going on not sure what everybody else wanted, but certainly was something I enjoyed.It definitely had my attention right up to the very end. I thought Nicole and Leiv Did a great job.I am not sure why I have to write 300 words or more so this is accepted.

title: Just so-so
author: dianalouise-14425
body: Hoped it would better, Nicole K is overall very good in her role. Hard to really like any of the characters in.this drama but that's also what keeps you going. Always great to see her ( Nicole Kidman) however, the other performances are sometimes lack-luster by some of the cast's characters, in my opinion. And, some of the characters are just not all that likeable lol. Watched all in one sitting, I expected it to be less soapy and more of a serious who-dun-it. That being said, I enjoyed it overall, just didn't LOVE it. The ending was satisfying and does finally answer all your questions. Fluffy but entertaining.

title: Unfathomably bad
author: ameliagenewatson
body:
What an absolute dogs dinner of a show.I felt so compelled to express my opinion that I signed up for an account on here...
What does Netflix have on Nicole Kidman that she keeps agreeing to star in these vapid, non-sensical sh** shows?! (She does look absolutely amazing though, props to her surgeon). The only watchable scenes are ones with Dakota Fanning, who is still criminally underused. The show fails to determine if it's funny or not..the characters just seem to forget there was a murder at all throughout. A warning to all - you will want to finish once you start, but in a masochistic way to satisfy your hatred. I am now dumber since watching, may God have mercy on my soul.

title: The extravagant and funny new Netflix series
author: saolivaresm
body: Susanne Bier and Jenna Lamia adapt Elin Hilderbrand's book in a stimulating way, in a series that starts with everything and ends with a correct ending, although a little weaker than its beginning.The new Netflix series is packed with interesting elements that make it a pleasant pastime, starting with a luxury cast that is truly inspired, especially Nicole Kidman and Eve Hewson, who stand out as the great queens of the show; to that we must add some fun supporting characters that frame the absolute success of having a luxury cast.With a script that gives us a fun and sexy story that works well within the limits of the formula, allowing for some perfect cliffhangers and leaving us with some deliciously horrible characters with whom you get various emotions and satisfactions, it is greatly helped by the effectiveness of a cast where everyone is allowed to shine without restraints, from Dakota Fanning to Jack Reynor, also passing through Liev Schreiber or Isabelle Adjani.Although its greatest strength lies in its first three chapters, where it cleverly manages to create that hook that, as a viewer, keeps you wanting to know more, as the ending progresses, it loses a bit of intensity, but maintains an eye-catching intrigue enough to make it a pleasant and very enjoyable experience, even if it goes down a few steps in its final stretch.Its ability and striking extravagance in the end up being the main reason why the series works genuinely throughout its entire run. In addition, we cannot ignore its good production and direction work that allows it to give a certain category to a pastime that is enjoyable to watch both for its characters and certain decisions that, whether strategic or simplistic, end up being a good hook to win you over as a viewer.Netflix has left us with a sexy and fun series in its catalog, with an impressive cast that works perfectly in all its aspects, making it almost impossible to resist binge-watching this elegant detective drama.

title: Wigged out
author: fionastaun
body: The main thing to capture attention in this uneven flat-pack is the very on-budget wigs. Obviously no budget was allowed and back costume lots were raided.First up is Nicole Kidman's wig. It turns in a very rigid performance around the dry centre part, and bobs very unevenly around the halfway curls as the tension increases. It changes colour sometimes to add intrigue, but generally remains quite washed out. But wait there's more wiggery to come ... all bad ...There's a frightening appearance by a dense black wig that speaks appalling French. Masses of dark brooding locks allow the wearer to peer through and deliver random threats.There's droopy ones, red-haired terrible cut ones and wibbly wobbly ones. At least they are something to follow.

title: Sourpuss
author: Dickiebyrne
body: Three episodes in and the face of Amelia is doing my head in. Miserable looking for the whole three episodes. Yeah her friend died, though not sure she really knew her but I can't be looking at her for another three episodes with a sourpuss on her.Why she isn't running for the hills away from this self serving family, is the bigger mystery here rather than the murder itself.There's a little mix of Knives Out here with the family looking wholesome from the outside but on closer inspection there are cracks that offer the viewer that it's a screwed up situation, the strong grip of the mother slowly slipping. Only we don't have a Benoit Blanc to get to the bottom of it. Just two episodes and 30 odd more minutes until the murderer is unveiled.

title: A soap opera murder mystery that doesn't take itself too seriously
author: cliew5473-107-917925
body: I watched this because I couldn't find anything else to watch at the time. It was entertaining enough for me to watch it all the way through to the end over a period of a few days, but I can see how some people would not like this series. It is a soap opera murder mystery, with many scenes and characters being quite quirky. But I think the fact that it is light and doesn't take itself too seriously is what keeps it entertaining as well as the fact that, in true whodunnit fashion, it keeps you guessing (or at least wondering) until the end. It's interesting to see Nicole Kidman play such a pretentious and unlikable character. It's almost as if the script was written especially for her. But what really surprised me about this series is that one of its actors is Isabelle Adjani -- a French actress that I really adored many, many years ago when I first saw here play Camille Claudel. I had no idea she would take on roles or films such as this one, so it was funny to see her play the role that she does here. In fact, at first, I couldn't even believe my eyes that it was her, so I had to look it up to confirm. Anyways, if you're just looking for mindless entertainment and don't have high expectations, you'll enjoy this film. Just don't expect to be able to take it too seriously, because even the film itself doesn't do that.

title: Intriguing. Entertaining. Love the humor.
author: BulletProofGirl
body: Not sure what the bad reviews were about but this was intriguing & entertaining for me and I love the humor. Also love the cast and their acting. Only people who watch something holistically can truly appreciate a good show. If you pay attention to each character, how natural they all play their respective roles and how clever the flow of the narrative was, this is easily one of the best and most entertaining whodunnit mysteries there is. I like everything about it - the plot, the characters, the twist, the dialogues. Everything about this show is good. The funny thing is that my fave character turned out to be the murderer.

title: Nope, something is missing
author: magdalenabhooi
body:
Ok i liked the opening scene where all the actors and the staff were dancing. My concern is Nicole Kidman and lack of her facial expressions she looks like a zombie and literally ruins the whole series m the scenes where you could see both: her fave bad hands were actually scary.Other than that I loved Thomas.(Jack Raynor) and Dakota Fanning. Obviously Netflix has spent a lot of money on that show: top cast, location, real luxury clothes and home appliances
However right after the Ideal Couple I have watched another crime mini series and it was on a totally different level of entertainment and how well paced it was. You don't need to spend a fortune once the story is good.

title: Liked book better
author: ashtster
body: The series has a great cast of actors. I enjoyed the scenic view of Nantucket. I heard they did film there so that is a plus given lot of series get filmed somewhere else even though they say they are at xyz location. I like the authenticity of this.The book has cliffhangers later as you don't know about the affairs until much later so it's all new. The series gives the spoilers too quickly in my opinion. The series deviates from book in having total different side stories where people know each other already and different names. More flashbacks and twist in book telling story much better. TE.

title: Loved this series!!
author: vanessatyler-67862
body: Loved this series! Excellent performances and lots of red herrings! Nicole Kidman does it again, and who doesn't love Liev Schreiber? Nantucket felt like its own character and had me looking up Airbnb and the best airport to fly into! Stories about how the other half live are always intriguing and this one was no different. Nicole Kidman's rant about taking care of everyone was intense and relatable. I don't want to give anything away, but an entertaining show that keeps you guessing as to who the murderer is. I didn't feel that it was soap opera-y at all, but that's just my opinion! Also, the sheriff and detective were fantastic. Just a great cast overall!.

title: So bad
author: hhwvbssn
body: This series is so bad. None of these people even seem like real human beings. Everyone is just literally screwing everyone else, either literally or figuratively. The dialogue is so incredibly superficial and contrived. Nicole Kidman looks like a freaking mannequin. Maybe the super-rich ARE reptilians! Because the way these people are portrayed is so odd. Dakota Fanning is way better than this, super disappointed in her even being a part of this train wreck. What kind of person forgives their fiancée for cheating on their wedding weekend. It's all so sick and so unbelievable. And what's with the stupid line dancing intro? Just AWFUL.

title: Ignore the Reviews & Watch for Yourself
author: akwilliams75
body: I really don't understand the hate for this one. I enjoyed it. It's an above average mystery that is easy to watch. There are a lot of satirical undertones, which I personally enjoy. Perhaps some people miss that.The cast is good across the board. (And of course, Nicole Kidman.) I was entertained and looked forward to watching each episode - and those are my is my top requirements for this type of programming. It is enjoyable escapist viewing.Watch the first episode and judge for yourself. It doesn't seem to be everybody's cup of tea, but I think that's where most programming goes wrong now.

title: Bad directing and some bad acting
author: cfreereign
body: Ok, I deleted my original review which I rated 2 stars. The show is really redeemed partially by Nicole Kidman and Dakota Fanning, largely, and Eve Hewson too. But I think the real problem comes down to writing and directing.The camera angles and closeups at times are just cringe, jarring and puzzling. Like whose perspective are we seeing? It's just bad film directing. It feels like there is a novice behind the camera, because it wanders, it squints, it pivots angles without reason. Very amateurish.But apart from that this could have been a thoroughly solid viewing experience, and I found myself watching purely because of the aforementioned acting, the production and the location set...

title: A good cast can't save a bad script!
author: FMM11
body: It is very evident that the writer of this show has never spent any time on Nantucket prior to filming and is writing about a world that is so foreign to them. Everything about this show is contrived and forced and filled with stupid clichés. There are so many missed opportunities for comic moments and there is nothing thrilling or mysterious about this pointless murder story. Not even one moment of suspense! The writer and director clearly haven't done any research on how the upper class lives on Nantucket or how they behave. You would never see any such characters on the Island. They looked and dressed and behaved more like an East Hampton mixed with Jersey Shore set. NOTHING about the story or the characters is credible! And that's why everything falls flat! It's why there's nothing funny or suspenseful about this tedious waste of a production. And the equation around white + wealthy= bad is so tired and needs to be put to rest. The writer clearly never interviewed a police officer either because interrogations don't happen the way they were ridiculously enacted on screen. I'm shocked that great actors would agree to perform such a lousy script! Not even their talent could compensate for the lack of substance all around.

title: Very entertaining!
author: grungeful
body: I really enjoyed watching this short series. Six episodes, one season and the mystery is solved. Suspenseful, funny and chic. Nicole Kidman amazing as usual. Meghann Fahy Is beautiful and heartbreakingly vulnerable in the middle of all these sharks. On the other hand, one wonders what Isabelle Adjani is doing here. She was for French cinema in the 80s and 90s what Kidman is now. In this show, her role is absolutely grotesque, full of bad cliché and even a great actress like her cannot pull it off. Not sure why the show is criticized but I have seen way worse and way less entertaining on Netflix.

title: Very interesting and underrated
author: WellnessDesigner
body: This TV show is so intelligently done and I truly enjoyed the atmosphere from the beginning until the end. Every character is thick, brilliant cast, this show delivered exactly what expected. It is showing, in a very sophisticated way, decadence of one wealthy, "I am bored, let's buy a donkey" wealthy family, and all put in a nice and smooth crime-drama genre. Placed in a perfect remote isolated spot, the plot is developing slowly but tense and it is definitely holding the attention. The rhythm is not for the audience who enjoys a bit of fast action or more dynamic TV crime drama, but I liked the rhythm here, because it suits the place and the characters. It felt like reading a good book, which I think was the idea of the creator. Well done and recommended.

title: The REAL mystery here is ....
author: brenda_loves_to_freecycl
body: Why a series set in Nantucket (a primarily Caucasian community) featuring a primarily Caucasian cast, opens with a Bollywood-style dance number in the opening credits.Setting that issue aside, it was an entertaining mystery. It is no "Big Little Lies", but it was a decent mystery.Admittedly, the ending was a bit anti-climactic.Nicole Kidman continues to look amazing. Hard to believe she is 57. A lot of actresses her age try to fight aging with plastic surgery, and end up looking like they're wearing a mask..The Nantucket scenery was the real star of the series. All those ocean-front homes.

title: Big Little Lies meets Clue
author: RedCupCoffee
body: I suspect it's some of the same writers who had a hand in 'Big Little Lies' same type of format, the police interrogation scenes, the dogged local sheriff and crime investigator, exact same theme. It's a classic whodunit-type murder. It's a fun ride, nothing groundbreaking, it's a fun thing to keep in the background while you're folding laundry or doing your nails. The scenery is beautiful, the actors are casual, the costumes are nice, it's a fun thing to watch, even a nice twist at the end.
