I liked it, it's not a classic or a cinematic masterpiece, but it is fun. I particularly loved the intro where they're all dancing, quite the catchy tune.

title: Not Near Perfect
author: M_Light
body: A rating of 7/10 is the equivalent of "average".The Perfect Couple is a show that centers around a wealthy family, preparing to host a wedding for their son and soon-to-be daughter in law. Upon their preparations, a murder occurs on the premises of their lavish house, which triggers a series of investigations that begin to unravel hidden secrets that surround each member of the family.Story-wise, the show isn't bad. You will be treated to a series of revelations that are "shocking". Generally, I thought the writing was laughable, though. Most of the characters are entertaining, with special emphasis on Liev Schreiber's character. The acting is pretty decent. I thought Dakota Fanning did a great job with her role.Although an "OK show", I thought the episodes ran a little too long for my taste. I don't usually binge shows, so I had difficulty maintaining patience as I went along.All in all, The Perfect Couple is somewhat worth watching. It had its moments at times, but certainly nothing special to offer. I would say that it was fun, but not worthwhile.

title: Sit back and enjoy
author: Sissy111
body: The Perfect Couple on Netflix offers a gripping blend of romance, mystery, and suspense. It has a proper plot - and some to spare. I will be surprised if there is anyone who can resist bingeing all six episodes once they have started!Visually, the show excels with its picturesque setting, capturing the charm of Nantucket and the luxury of a high-profile wedding. The cinematography enhances the beauty of the location while also adding a sense of eeriness to the unfolding drama.The acting is solid, with standout performances that bring depth to complex relationships. The tension between family dynamics and personal ambitions is portrayed with authenticity, and the mystery at the heart of the series kept me engaged until the very end.This is such a treat. Sit back and enjoy.

title: Adequate Entertainment
author: tvsafnari
body: If you want to enjoy this show, it is very important that your expectations are reasonable. Truth to be told, this show is pretty ok, in almost all aspects, script, acting, character building, plot etc. Everything is good enough to keep you engaged, and interested in what is happening. If you want some light, not-too-serious entertainment, this show delivers perfectly. I watched it while mildly sick, which fit very nicely with my mood and I got everything I wanted from this show. Over all the characters were likeable and had engaging archs and were believable enough within the context of the show.If you go in with reasonable expectations, this show is a solid 6.5/10, and perfect to watch when you don't feel like investing too much in a show.

title: A fun watch that somehow just misses the mark.
author: Tushpi
body: This had all the elements of a good old fashioned 'who done it'. Gorgeous scenery, super rich people living decadent lives full of secrets. An ensemble cast of some of my favourite actors. I was hoping for a crime caper a la Agatha Christie. It just however misses the mark. The main issues for me start with Nicole Kidman's face. It's so odd looking. It's a testament to her incredible acting talent that I could discern some of her emotions, given how devoid of expression it was. Please Nicole stop with the procedures. Isabelle Adjanji hiding under her age under her hair and thick makeup was very distracting. She looked plastic.Some of the side plot lines were underdeveloped and some pointless. The 2 cop's investigative approach was implausible in terms of procedure but they were fun to watch. Meghan Fahy however was luminous as the best friend, lighting up the screen in every scene she appeared. She really stood out.If you put all the negatives aside, this is an easy fun watch with lots of red herrings and all revealed by the final episode. It just could have been so much better. The fault I think lies in the script which lacks tension, with most of the characters superficial, but it's watchable and unchallenging.

title: Typical Whodunit: A Fun Escape
author: linastorme
body: A typical whodunit that serves its purpose as a captivating, fun distraction. It's not bad, but not great either-just good. Meghann Fahy's performance truly stole the show, bringing depth to her role. Jack Reynor's character, Thomas, was amusingly frustrating; I felt an overall disdain for his spoiled rich white man persona. Yet, his laughter at his family's desperate attempts to maintain their façade somehow resonated with me and made him a bit likeable. Nicole Kidman, as always, acts excellently as a rich madam with a brilliant poker face-you can never quite tell if she's genuinely nice or not. It's classic rich-people drama, perfect for a bit of escapism.

title: Do not waste your time
author: rosscorr-1
body: More junk television. Totally forgettable and totally tedious. The dialogue is risible and delivered by a cast of second rate actors. Kidman again delivers a performance of stupefying banality. It feels like she has read the script in the trailer and delivered it to the director in one take. Seeing a lot of rich people being rich no longer feels unique or compelling. How many fancy houses and cars is enough? Coupled with and a cast of wooden stereotypes such as the jaded detective and the maid/housekeeper who you have seen a thousand times before this very well may have been written by AI. Just stop making this junk.

title: Big Little Lies meets The White Lotus
author: ReadMyReview
body: **Review of "The Perfect Couple"**From the moment I started watching "The Perfect Couple," I was hooked and couldn't turn it off. The series is packed with twists and turns that keep you on the edge of your seat, making it a thrilling binge-watch. While it may not reach the heights of "The White Lotus," it's certainly right up there, exploring the complexities of wealth and relationships.Nicole Kidman shines, as always, bringing depth and nuance to her role. The rest of the cast is equally strong, creating a dynamic ensemble that captivates throughout. The stunning backdrop of Nantucket serves as an enchanting setting, making me wish I could visit this affluent island myself.As I watched the characters navigate their glamorous lives, I couldn't help but feel a pang of envy for their luxurious lifestyles. It's a reminder that I'm just contributing to their wealth by watching from my couch. The pacing is excellent, with each episode revealing new layers and keeping you guessing.In summary, "The Perfect Couple" is a must-watch for fans of drama and intrigue. It may not eclipse "The White Lotus," but it's an engaging series that will keep you entertained and wanting more.

title: It's just a miniseries
author: lprofettoshopping
body: All the horrible reviews are unnecessary. This miniseries was fluff, the book was fluff. It was not designed to be an Oscar worthy epic! I thoroughly enjoyed it, the actors seemed to have fun with the over the top characters. I thought a lot of the dialogue was amusing. Laughed out loud at Elle Fanning's declaration of "this is vintage!" Rich people DO behave abhorently sometimes. They are clueless about reality. The only area of suspended disbelief is they would have had their attorneys in there lickety split, but it would have ruined the plot. Nicole was fabulous as always. Liev was smarmy and sexy as ever. My undergraduate school was full of Toms, so that actor got it right. I loved the maid! Calm down, have a G&T and enjoy!

title: Is Nicole Kidman OK? Is someone forcing her to become a soap actress?
author: jessica-nussbaumer
body: Big Little Lies was excellent, a bit soapy, but with a well developed story with interesting & complex characters that was very well acted. Ever since then, Kidman has starred in series that have become progressively worse, but I'm not sure one can get worse than The Perfect Couple.I don't want to get into too much detail, but literally everyone is cartoonishly awful in this story, I'm not sure if it was supposed to be a comedy, but I laughed hard enough for it to be. (My laugh lines were visible, but I can't say the same for a few of the female leads.) The dance number every episode? Why? Just why? I'm trying to understand how renowned actress Nicole Kidman thought "This sounds great! Sign me on!"I could have answered you as to who committed the murder within the first episode, but Netflix decided we needed to suffer through 5 more episodes of watching terrible rich people. I would recommend watching The White Lotus or Big Little Lies if that tickles your fancy.

title: Toner for Benji's hair, stat!
author: kelly-90368
body: I read all the other reviews, and they are mostly spot on. This limited series won't likely receive any Emmy nominations, but it's a fun "whodunnit". Beautiful, rich family. Stunning scenery. Overacting? Yes. Dull acting? At times. Expect something that you would find on the Hallmark Channel. Dakota Fanning giving "Jane" from Twilight vibes worked. Nicole Kidman doing the ice queen thing worked. Could they have toned Benji's hair color? It literally distracted me at times! Ha! I actually found myself watching the opening credits to see their wedding group dance scene. Might've been one of the better things about this series? I could possibly see them making this into a regular series if they do some work on the screenplay and character development. Give it a try!

title: People need to chill
author: tyqxfxdcn
body: Are you people expecting perfection every time you watch a show or movie? So many negative reviews and 1 star ratings. Really? You think this show is as bad as could possibly be? That's what the one implies.The show is exactly what it advertised, a silly cartoon with decent jokes based of a admittedly meh card game. I personally like the relationship between GC and DC. The family is not exactly new or unique, but they stick to their cliche roles and do it well. Chill out, lower your standards and have a little fun. If all you ever expect is the best then you will be constantly disappointed. Thanks for reading.

title: Not a Slow Motion Video Lapse of an Actual Exploding Cat
author: raymondjohnston-71909
body:
I sat down one night, popcorn in hand,
To watch "Jurassic Park," the best in the land.But what did I see? To my surprise,
Exploding kittens before my eyes!Cartoon cats, oh so cute,
Blowing up, in hot pursuit.Expecting dinos, but got this instead,
Funny felines messing with my head.Their antics were wild, their humor quite bold,
A show full of laughter, stories untold.No T-Rex roaring, no Velociraptor chase,
Just kittens with bombs all over the place.Animation bright, voices so clear,
Quirky adventures, plenty to cheer.Though it wasn't the dino flick I craved,
"Exploding Kittens" still had me enslaved.A solid 7, for fun and delight,
But for Jurassic thrills, I'll switch tonight.Kittens, you were great, you played your part,
But nothing beats dinos, they steal my heart.

title: I cannot tell a lie, I expected this to suck
author: orcinussr
body: Perhaps the mere fact that my low expectations were so widely exceeded OR.. or... And bear with me now (is it 'bear' or 'bare'? ).. OR perhaps it's just REALLY GOOD (cause it IS), but I'm loving this! And for the official record, my pedigree in western animation is substantial (don't tell anyone but I actually watch em all, which for a middle aged white guy, is sad?) but, ya this is solid 100 percent worth your time! Animation 9 voice acting 9 Story 9 (so why did I give it an 8? Lol, cause for me 9s are 10s and I reserve 10s for the all time like an Attenborough documentary or Rick and Morty, sooo...)

title: Meh
author: burninatable
body: Yeah...so I gave this a fair shot since I figured a lot of the negative reviews were just brigaiding from the religious lot. Nah though, it's just not that great.It feels like the "hello fellow kids, I too enjoy musicband" of adult animation. The jokes aren't *bad* but they are kinda stale and tryhard. The visual gags are a little bit better, but only a little bit. The dialogue/voice acting is a kind of Upbeat Quirky Snark™ that was already feeling done to death 10 years ago. It just feels so, so generic, "safe", like it was made purely for mass commercial appeal by a panel of old men.The parenting jokes are overdone and not well integrated. The teens are so clearly written by adults that don't know any teens. The cats are seriously underutilised and when they do get screen time it's more imitation edginess that just doesn't land. It's boring. It's a shame because the concept isn't a bad one, it just totally fails to deliver.I can't even call it bad - it's not interesting enough to be bad - but it's really not good either.

title: Too nice
author: hydralien-40230
body: What's great about other Oatmeal's art is its cute sarcasm: it's sharp and unforgiving, yet kinda lovable. Even monster babies are adorable, in their own disgusting way - but it's still delivering the point, like "cats rules, babies suck", and the like.Here, the cuteness of the characters is all there - the art style of the drawings is transitioned into the animation quite impeccably: everything looks ugly and beautiful at the same time. The voice acting is a good match, too - mostly, anyway. But the sarcasm is severely lacking.It's just too nice.Don't get me wrong, there still are fairly sharp jokes and puns and some sarcastic attitude (like the fair part of the SeaWorld episode), but the whole premise of God being selfish jerk is lost pretty much in episode 1, and the evil is pretty much never materialises at any point. And all the family values...Too nice.

title: Loved this!!!
author: Pmdmnym
body: First of all I will say, I didn't know it was a game but I just loved this!!! Tom Ellis' voice made this for me, knew it immediately and great casting! I'm surprised at the low ratings and I think it should be all 10's. I definitely lol'd throughout and actually binged it, went right through and enjoyed every single minute. I recommend this to everyone I know, especially cat lovers. I agree with one reviewer who said everyone needs to relax and chill out! This was never meant to win an Oscar, it's just pure comedic entertainment. Although I think I'm going to rewatch Lucifer again! Need me some Tom Ellis.

title: Exploding Kittens: A Purr-fectly Explosive Delight
author: Bmore-Hero
body: Exploding Kittens is an absolute blast! The show brilliantly captures the quirky, fun essence of the original card game, delivering laugh-out-loud moments in every episode. The animation is vibrant and energetic, perfectly complementing the zany antics of the characters. The humor is spot-on, appealing to both kids and adults alike, with witty dialogue and clever scenarios that keep you eagerly awaiting the next explosion of fun. Whether you're a fan of the game or new to the franchise, Exploding Kittens is a must-watch for anyone looking for a wildly entertaining and hilariously unpredictable experience.

title: A good cartoon
author: liamde-25013
body: I've seen some negative reviews of this show that I don't really agree with. The humour is not the most original or deep but it still works. The reason why I want to see this get higher reviews is that it's the first direct to steaming adult cartoon I have seen in a long time that actually cares about the animation. It has its own look, unique character designs ,fluidity, colour, all the things that Netflix animation has lacked few years. And they haven't fill that with celebrity voiceovers which is a big Plus it's been a long last time since I saw a cartoon that used professional voice actors and I think it makes a difference.

title: What the hell and heaven did I just watch?
author: lulu3333
body: I've never played the famous card game, so I'm not sure if not being familiar with it affected my experience watching this animation.Initially when seeing god turn into a cat, I got very excited. The cat moments made me smile, like knocking things off tables, going crazy over the laser pointer etc.Then it became boring and I stopped watching.The next day I gave it another chance, probably because I was in a different mood. This time I kept watching until the end and I didn't get bored again.I was more drawn to devilcat, she felt cuter to me, but I also liked the chaotic relationship between her and godcat. The ending was quite interesting and I'm curious to see what the next season brings (hopefully more kittens!)Yeah, the show is not great, but it's not awful either. Maybe you just need to be in the right mood to watch it, without expectations, being prepared for silly things, like weird monsters and foolish action moments, combined with family issues/lessons and some sarcastic comments about generational stereotypes.It's mostly an adult cartoon, even if it feels teens would appreciate it more, but I don't think they would get all of the jokes.

title: Laughing is a struggle with this one
author: johansenjack-70064
body: This is a bit of a stinker, so I'm not sure how other reviews are rating it soo high but I'm not laughing. I wanted to be fair so I'm fighting through more than i want to watch.Finding out Mike Judge was a producer is salt in the wound as Office space is 1 of my favorite comedies. King of the hill had it's time too. Maybe i assumed because it's Netflix and it popped up on my feed, that this would be more adult but NOPE. It's feeling more of a young teen comedy. So far the only times I've laughed or smiled, is cat based jokes, like a laser pointer joke and how cats push things off tables.The premise is sorta interesting i guess but i can definitely see that this will get backlash from Christians. It's not even that God is a cat, he's portrayed as having a disdain for humans.There's not much else to say about this show, maybe you will like it and maybe, like me, you won't. Or maybe you will never read this, as this is my first review.Thanks for coming out.

title: What a refreshing animation!
author: asteras
body: It is on the same level as good as Family Guy or American Dad, beautifully executed and super hilarious, thanks!But just because IMDB insist on longer reviews, here's an extended version: " Sure! Here's the expanded review:This animation stands on the same level of excellence as shows like Family Guy and American Dad. The execution is nothing short of beautiful, blending sharp, vibrant visuals with fluid motion that keeps the eye engaged. The humor is super hilarious, striking a perfect balance between wit and absurdity, ensuring that every episode leaves you in stitches. The characters are well-developed, each with their own unique quirks and comedic timing that adds depth and variety to the show. The storyline is consistently entertaining, with clever writing and unexpected twists that keep you eagerly anticipating what comes next. Overall, it's a fantastic blend of humor, artistry, and storytelling that makes it a must-watch for any animation enthusiast. Thanks for creating such an enjoyable show!"

title: Not bad, but that's it.
author: krisztian113
body:
Did not finished it yet, as Binge-watching always results in half understanding and enjoying something, but watched enough to see, that this cartoon is not a bad one, but does not really translates the fun of the base material.Not like it's an easy task to do. It's a card game... Yet the animated "shorts" they made for these card games were always had the dark humor, that every time made me want to see more.Well... This is not like those. Still an allrightish cartoon and i think i will finish it, but it's more like a story that got filled with some stuff from Exploding kittens, and used the name of the card game to fish viewers than a cartoon made with the "spirit" of the card game.So. TL;DR:
Watch it, and decide it yourself, but think of it as a cartoon with cats and dark humor instead of Exploding Kittens. That will help.

title: Yes... er... no.
author: Wookieetreiber
body: It's like so many other things: take a well-known and popular brand, put a mentally totally broken team of writers to the task of making a cartoon series filled with faecal language and sell the whole thing as the millionth bland copy of South Park that shows how culturally and socially rotten our world is.I'll tell you something without giving anything away: it's not funny. It's stupid.Yes, every now and then a teenager might smile because... he's a teenager. The rest switches back to Rick and Morty. It may not be exactly Shakespeare either, but it's still more creative than that and, above all, more or less an original idea.Switch off and play the card game with family or friends. That's always better than this.

title: Funny show, but why is it TV-MA?
author: dylanarnold-78562
body: This show is funny, but why in the world is it TV-MA!? There is literally nothing explicit! There is gore and some references but absolutely NO PROFANITY IN THE ENTIRE 9 EPISODES! WHY TV-MA? This show was super entertaining and had me laughing the whole time, it was pretty fun and I had an overall good time. I hope this gets green lit for season 2 because I enjoyed it and had a fun time watching it. It wasn't perfect, but it did its job well, I was laughing and smiling while watching and wasn't ever bored. So I give seven stars because I was entertained and spit out my water multiple times because it was so funny!

title: I thought it was hilarious.
author: ChristyGuinn
body: Not gonna lie I smoked up real good before and during so I was dying laughing. I can admit it might've been altered thinking. But the jokes landed, a lot! The characters were funny. I loved many of the dry whited one liners. For real! I mean come on..."he's like an onion ring that learned to cuss" that's funny to me. Some goofy immature humor. Some great references to pop culture. I don't know what all made me like it, I just do. You'd know from episode one if it's for you. They get funnier but if you're rolling your eyes in episode one. Just stop there, no harm. If you like it, well then just sit back smoke and enjoy.

title: Fun and relaxing
author: cosminbianu
body: Love the series. Tom Ellis is a great fit for the role; recognised the voice but couldn't quite pin it to him, even after watching the entire Lucifer series (it was a pleasant surprise). The script is no masterpiece by any means, but miles ahead of most things coming out these days. It is fun, original, with minimal filler content. It skips some cliche moments and makes the most of the 25 minutes per episode. The premise is quite original as well and manages to blend the feline and religious aspects surpsingly well. The animators did a great job, especially animating the cats. The way Godcat's and Devilcat's movements and facial expressions are drawn is very satisfying. Again, don't expect this to be your next Emmy nominee, but it has the potential to be. It is certainly my favourite in the genre so far.I'd love to see another season. It was a very relaxing and enjoyable series (expecially for cat lovers). Already bought the game to further support the series.

title: It was supposed to be good
author: MeReviewsFilms
body: I'm a huge fan of Matt Inman, also known as The Oatmeal. He has one of the greatest sense of humor out there and it shows through everything that he does. His writing, his drawing style, and the card game that he invented. So how could this drivel even exist? I would believe that he didn't have anything to do with it and simply sold the franchise to Netflix to give it the "Netflix Treatment (tm)" which usually turns into unsatisfying forgetable content (yeah, not "film", not "TV", just "content.") The issue here is that it simply is not funny. It didn't make me smile even once. Ultimately, I stopped watching the pilot even though there was still 5 mins left to go. So, my advice to The Oatmeal fans out there: skip this, you'll be utterly disappointed.

title: Very solid show
author: dannypepper
body: I didn't know what to expect going into the show I just knew the thumbnail was interesting. After I started watching it I could not stop laughing. The jokes write themselves and I enjoyed every bit of it. I definitely recommend this show and definitely would like a couple more seasons to end it right. It was a refreshing adult animation which we don't really see too many of those because a lot of them seem like they're kind of like rinse and repeat but this show definitely wasn't that. The title of the show did throw me off like I was expecting a little bit more action but once the joke started coming I couldn't stop laughing.

title: If you came here because you love the Oatmeal you're in the wrong place.
author: IllieT
body: We were eagerly anticipating this show for months because we're fans of Matthew Inman and his sense of humor. We love The Oatmeal and the games he's created so we thought this would be similarly smart and funny. It's not. If that's what brought you to the show, you're in for a huge disappointment. For those who watch it without any expectations founded on his other projects however, is seems to go over better. The show is filled with kind of humor that might make you chuckle once every few episodes. Exploding Kittens fits right in with most of the forgettable content made by Netflix.Tl; Dr not for fans of The Oatmeal.

title: Chaotic fun for the whole family
author: kirkkalon
body: Exploding kittens takes the chaos of the card game and captures it in animated form making it a fun watch relatable to the annoyances of humanity, however instead of using the unique designs and outlandish characters from inman's wide range of card games he falls on a formulistic story mocking common sit com tropes. The creator has brief Easter eggs and references to his games and comics but it doesn't actually seem to relate to the game play of any of them. We need to see how having his characters and mythological characters and cryptids in heaven and hell actually makes this world unique. Season 2 should build the world based on the card game and those included in show not just the worst of earths society and religion.

title: An adult animation full of light hearted fun.
author: fjoltul
body: The first season is an absolute hit!My wife and I decided to give it a shot, and I'm glad we did. This series is an effortless watch, despite some of the humor occasionally missing the mark. Its light-hearted and whimsical nature makes it perfect for having on in the background while working or delving into a project. It's important not to take this series too seriously. At its core, this is yet another adult cartoon series, and it hits that familiar, comforting target with pinpoint accuracy.The animation style is almost like a news paper's comic strip, it's captivating, the characters are quirky, and the storyline, while simple, is engaging enough to keep you entertained. The creators have clearly poured a lot of passion into this project, and it shows. The blend of absurdity and humor, even when it falters, adds to the charm and makes for a delightful viewing experience.We eagerly await the second season and am excited to see how the story and characters evolve. This series has the potential to become a staple in the realm of adult animated shows.

title: There is no way this is written by Matthew Inman
author: WithinSamsara
body: This series is a disaster. I am a huge Matthew Inman fan and have been following oatmeal since the start. I love a good story and I spend a lot of time watching cartoons with stupid humor.This is just... Cringe. I feel terrible writing that. I feel someone somewhere has put their input on Inman's writing or Inman just cannot write a series. It isn't insane or strange in the way say Spongebob, adventure time or any of the other American adult cartoons are. It is just cringe. There is too much suspension of belief of logic needed and it is a chore trying to go through a single episode.I usually try to give every series I watch a fair hand shake of watching the first 3 episodes before calling it quits. This was by far the hardest to get through and I feel disheartened because I wanted to like this series. I really really wanted this to be good. I say this not because of expectations being crashed but because I genuinely like Matthew Inman's online persona and wanted it to succeed. I feel bad trashing a show who's author I respect for his other works. Again I am not writing this or being critical because my expectations were shattered or I had certain threshold of quality I demand. It is intrinsically bad writing.

title: The Kid Loves It
author: rblan-69613
body: Letting my nine year old write a blurb down below because he'd like to see another season from them. As a parent, with a fairly mature child, I was fine with letting him watch the show. He loves playing the card game with his grandparents and uncles and he was really excited that they were making an animated series.It's funny enough and mostly what you'd expect from a project with Mike Judge's involvement (we're still a couple of years away from Bevis and Butthead - both old and new).Now that I've met the character requirements, here's Walter's review:I love the series, the story and the game I want them to make a season 2 of exploding kittens.

title: I just don't get it
author: matt-66527
body: Wasn't that funny. I just don't get it at all. It's trying to be a funny adult cartoon but it just doesn't land for me. It also has nothing to do with the game, which has a ton of super fans. So for me, it's a pass on watching this. I would not recommend it. I think you will almost certainly feel like you wasted a significant amount of your time. I watched it and wish I could get all of the hours of my life back, it was that cringy. I also didn't think a lot of the jokes were brave at all. It was the same jokes I've heard in countless other cartoons and it didn't feel unique at all. I highly recommend skipping.

title: Dark Humor Masterpiece
author: WatchAndSmile
body:
I absolutely loved it. Even though I am religious Christian, I love any and all fun as humor IS humor.I also like cats... and dark humor and action and this show delivered.In fact, I stopped watching the trailer after about 15 seconds as I just knew there's no point to continue and I will love it. If you liked Ted TV show and movies, this will be somewhat similar.I hope authors of this will bring more season with more episodes
There were a lot of LOL moments, a lot of chuckles and head shaking at the dialogs. Sometimes when I watch Simplson or Family guy, I am happy to smile a couple of times. This show is where my face was tired from smiling and grinning for the full duration of the episodes!!!It is NOT for everyone. Watch the trailer, know if it's your cup of tea. Don't be that guy who watches looney toons and scoobydoo and now hated this... lol.

title: Great animated series for grown ups
author: stijnman-ineke
body: This is a well written animated series with an amazing voice cast. Especially the choice for Tom Ellis, known for playing the Devil in Lucifer, as Godcat has worked out particularly well. His smooth soothing English accent as a contrast to the overweight big cat is very well chosen. The other voices are all good matches to their characters.The series itself is very entertaining and fun to look at, while also being socially engaged. Tackling several current day issues in family life and business, in a fast and fun way. The many (little and not so little) jokes and references to the film industry are hilarious.Towards the end the plot gets more and more exciting making vyou want to binge right to the very end.

title: Corny and cringey
author: yaellaraflores
body: I find it fair to assume that the average person would want watch a show to get a laugh every now and then while unwinding and find moments that feel somewhat relatable. It's the little things that draw the viewer's attention and has them seeking more by the end of an episode. This is none of that. The humor is backwards and expected to the point that it's cringe. Like a cat following a lazer, that was it? You won't find yourself genuinely laughing once. In order to be relatable characters have to play roles that we typically see in the real world so that you have room to add any funny scene you'd like. It seems like they spend their time focusing on maintaining the backwards roles of the characters rather than creating humor. I'm gonna compare it to a successful show like say American Dad, God plays the role of Roger the alien, the wife in this show plays the role of Stan, and the husband in this show is made out to be borderline mentally handicapped. To me the most infuriating part is how much they nerfed God. Like he's God.

title: Not great but its entertaining!
author: ericeguia
body: The show is better than average in my opinion. It's still worth giving a watch. Humour can be cheap sometimes and the mom is literally the only character that's not fat and out of shape. The show itself isn't that bad and is pretty funny for the most part. Hearing the voice they got to play Godcat is hilarious. All the bad reviews of this show seem a bit uncalled for but if you enjoy hearing Tom Kenny's voice in about 50% of this show then you will enjoy this! I never played the card game itself but it's nice seeing such a silly little tabletop game become an actual show that connects and resonates with the fans.

title: Wanted to like it
author: nathalieblocry
body: I love playing exploding kittens with all it's expansion pack. It never fails to entertain and never gets boring. I also enjoy the oatmeal cartoons. So I fully expected this to be my thing too but it's just not funny not clever and not entertaining. I only watched two episodes and I know some things need some episodes to grow on you but i'm just too bored to even want to continue.I find it strange that I find almost all of the exploding kittens cards funny, I find almost all of the oatmeal things funny but I didn't so much as giggle once while watching 2 full episodes. It's just something completely different it seems. No idea of who was involved in creating this. I do recognise the visual style but the humor /story has no resemblance to anything exploding kittens or oatmeal for me. Some other people seem to like it. Maybe they are just watching it without the expectation of any link ? ... I don't know but I feel genourous by giving it 3 stars. It just didn't get 1 or 2 stars because there's worse things on netflix/ tv not because there was anything I liked.

title: It's pretty good
author: neillayague
body: The comedy is aight I mean I've seen other adult animated shows that have more creative comedy but when this show drops a hard ass comedy it is a bit funny and the show also have very great animation overall and also this show certainly embraced adult animation as a whole with its gore and profanity that other animated series failes on which is impressive and also the show does NOT take itself very seriously like AT ALL which is good for comedy show. Now for the characters, they're decent Godcat is alright and devilcat as well both Sasheer and Tom did a great job adding charisma via their voice acting, and as always mark prosch and ally maki is good so I'm pretty happy in the outcome of the show as a whole. We'll see what next seasons got for us.

title: Quite funny actually
author: kalanuenigma
body: I am actually really enjoying the show. I chuckled through a few scenes and thought a few of the jokes were brilliant. I ended up binge watching 6 episodes last nigh.I don't understand the 1 star negative reviews - as someone previously mentioned, its a lighthearted cartoon. People are either expecting pure perfection which is basically their personal view of what perfection should be or they are simply trolling.Overall, I like the art style, the voice overs and the story. I have never heard of exploding kittens before and am not familiar with the card game.Also I love the voice of Tom Ellis - he is perfect for this role. I loved him in Lucifer.

title: Blecch. The Oatmeal it is NOT
author: willchristopherson-65681
body: If you came because The Oatmeal had a great sense of humor, and you enjoy Inman's sensibilities in his other endeavors, you're gonna be disappointed. It's not clever or cute, it's just bland and predictable. It feels like a cash grab on a popular brand, not made with care or love for what it is based on.That's all it's worth putting into this review, so I'll fill the rest of my character requirement by hitting the autocomplete keys randomly: the point of the game in the US and I've been using it to a few days ago. I think I have a friend who is a bit of a mood and is a good job for me. Ahh well it's just a matter of time.

title: Outstanding. And Without Cheap Shots or Vulgarity
author: MTZink
body: Hell, I laughed my ass out throughout the pilot (and well into Episode 2) so much that my own cats were getting nervous. And believe me, they've seen some odd monkey stuff on my end.Babbling due to the damn required characters. Oh, I could triple that when provoked but when REALLY IMPRESSED I'd rather just make a definite OUTSTANDING statement.EXCELLENT writing, characters and story throughout. Take note wannabe writers at quality humor through wit (and the actors) instead of the lame crutches of screaming curses, F-bombs or crotch jokes. Situation, characters and story. GD refre... er, pleasant change.

title: Gave up after two episodes
author: avandelay-57917
body: Listen, I gave it an honest try, but it's just not interesting nor funny. Side plots were pointless and unfunny (celebrating an historically significant tarter sauce mishap at a bulk goods store sounds like something chatgpt would come up with in response to "give me a stupid subplot for my cartoon"). My guess is the writers were rushing to fill the episodes out and just came up with random filler to pass time.For those who made it all the way thru the season, I can only imagine the circumstances of your situation. I will light some candles and pray for your speedy recovery and/or rescue (I assume you are either in a catatonic / paralyzed state or are being held against your will in a basement somewhere) Stay strong!

title: Reasonably boring
author: alessiovidalph
body: Started great, very funny. After episode one, I was already bored unfortunately. Still watching it because I want to finish the serie, but I am not liking it (ep 6 now). Started great, very funny. After episode one, I was already bored unfortunately. Still watching it because I want to finish the serie, but I am not liking it (ep 6 now). Started great, very funny. After episode one, I was already bored unfortunately. Still watching it because I want to finish the serie, but I am not liking it (ep 6 now).Overall something to keep in the background, but not interesting enough to keep you glued to the TV.

title: I Want More!!
author: thalassafischer
body: I totally adore the premise of this show and most of the episodes were awesome. Honestly, I did not like the one where God and Beelzebub go to Hell for a friend's wedding and they turn back into human-like creatures - I genuinely found it creepy and gross.I think there should be a second season where they're condemned to be cats for all of eternity because of some clause in a contract God made while he was still God. The fact that he's depicted as a generally harmless but self-absorbed deity who simply got lazy on the job is cute, and I think it provides endless fodder for hilarious rules he has to obey because of Natural Law.It only makes sense, what with cats being worshiped by some ancient cultures and I'm surprised there wasn't more of that in these episodes, so I am really hoping it means more is coming.

title: Enjoyment May Depend On If You Are Into The Show's Humor
author: jeremycrimsonfox
body: Exploding Kittens is an odd idea for a adult cartoon. Based on the card game of the same, the cartoon, which is on Netflix, attempts to put a story in, as God (voiced by Tom Ellis) is sent to Earth in the body of a cat to be rehabilitated to emphasize with the humans after too many incidents caused both in Heaven and on Earth. There, he must help the Higgens family, as one of them sent a prayer asking him to save the family, but it won't be easy when the family members have a lot of problems, and to make matters worse, Beelzebub (voiced by Sasheer Zamata) is also on Earth in the body of a cat to work on being as evil as her father.Yeah, this is another cartoon where your enjoyment will depend on whether or not you are into crude, mindless humor. The plot is actually quite original for once, and it does lead to some supernatural conflicts and elements. Plus, the voice acting is good, and the writing is okay, with some jokes not being to my taste.

title: One of my new favorite adult animations!
author: tylerjosephet
body: Absolutely hilarious! The smart undercover jokes that they sneak in are just perfect. It's nice to hear some familiar voices, and seeing some familiar names on the credits.At first I was weary about the title and concept but after just a few minutes into the first episode I was sold. Bright animation, with the more 2 d classic vibe which I really can appreciate. I will be patiently waiting for a season 2, I wish there were more episodes on this first season! I could binge this show for hours and hours on end. I about lost it on episode three when the karen character was introduced and was spot on.

title: IT IS ABSOLUTE PERFECTION
author: littlekingdom
body: The first few episodes are kinda average but, very entertaining. But as the series goes on it goes from great to MASTERPIECE!!! My favorite characters have to be Godcat and DevilCat. I especially love their relationship and character development. Devilcat's whole character feels somewhat nostalgic in a way since I really liked the evilish characters from shows and games. (Characters like the mage sisters from Kirby star allies) I love how this show gave me a blast from the past while still having an incredibly unique plot, that is full of suspense. And the ending was fun, chaotic, and satisfying!

title: Just not good
author: bpb99
body: Its just plainly a bad show. Somehow in order to review a show that is even this lazy and bad you need to supply a certain amount of characters. Nobody is freaking out, its just a matter of the review requirements..This show is basically everything wrong with western animated shows wrapped up into one. The comedy is super bad and relies solely on reference jokes. Don't get the reference? Sorry you missed the joke. But that's all of them which makes for a very unfunny and pretentious show.The show has some sort of plot/direction but rather than play into it, they just chose to infuse the random whenever possible. Here is a random unicorn.The description of 'adult animation' is much more in line with futurama or the simpsons, or cartoons from 20+ years ago - whereas they are/were actually just children's cartoons rather than something actually adult oriented like some of the new animated series that have come out over the past few years.I find the reviews that call this show 'fresh' or 'creative' pretty misleading as well because if you have watched bobs burgers, brickleberry and other more recent animated series this show is really just a cheap rip-off of multiple other shows and not as good as any of them. The comedy feels stale and without even looking I can garantuee its written by a writer from one of those other old cartoon shows, just looking to rework their stale comedy into a different aesthetic.If you consider the first season of legends of vox machina as a step forward in american adult animated series, this show is on the exact opposite spectrum.

title: Perfection and invalid criticism
author: nikolaynasypanyy
body: Ten stars seems a little too much, and, to be fair, it is (my honest rating is nine stars) but the criticism on this honestly wonderful cartoon is incredibly invalid and unfair to the point where it needs a counter. The people in modern day society have such high expectations. For my personal opinion, I think this cartoon is fantastic. Yes, the characters aren't the most original- tough navy mom, 9-5 board game enthusiast father, fat gamer/streamer son and unbelievably smart daughter. Very over-used character stereotypes, but even so, it.. doesn't have to be perfect! The whole premise of the series is a silly cartoon about a cat god. This was not meant to have characters with original, in-depth, loving and infuriating personalities! It's a comedy! I also, for one, think that the idea and plot are actually quite original! Yes, there are some aspects that aren't so original, none of which I wish to go over to not contain spoilers, but complete perfect originality in modern age is so hard to replicate that it's practically impossible! In conclusion, it is a quite funny series with an actually intriguing story-line with a very original concept and beautiful art-style! Nine out of ten! (plus one to counter invalid criticism)

title: Nothiingburger the series
author: calahao
body: I don't know if this is loyal to the card game, but whatever. It's not a good show.In it, God and Satan become cats and have to learn their lessons in order to be CEO's of their companies again. The concept of Heaven and Hell being CEO's was personally much better handled in Where The Demon Lurks, but that's the least of the show's problems.It has a very generic sense of humor. You have the full potential with just these two characters, and yet you choose to focus on a generic adult cartoon family, with a bumbling dad, nerd daughter and tough mom. I do relate to the son a little, as I too have been cyberbullied and doxxed, but otherwise he has little personality beyond that.A strong recommendation against.

title: Based Meme
author: Godcatcto
body: Come check out the GodCat CTO on solana. T.me/godcatsol Dev jeeted community took over. Let's send this kitty back to the top 10 trending on dexscreener. Just a matter of time before this show goes viral on Netflix, already global top 10 streaming. Couple weeks I predict it'll be #1. You're very early, $GODCAT will be the next 100x everyone is searching for they just haven't found it yet. The show is great, funny narrative gives people thoughts on religion from a comical creative perspective. That's why this community feels so strong about the meme and the potential it has in the near future. Interesting times ahead!

title: I LOVE this show! Intelligent, sarcastic and witty
author: UnkoJesse
body: If you watch the series "Exploding Kittens" with an open mind and no expectations of linking the show to the card game, you'll find that the writing is great, sarcastic and very clever. I think the storylines and the premise of the show are very funny and creative. The "devil cat" being a little compassionate and the "God cat" being a little sadistic is fun irony and breaks a lot of by-the-numbers story arcs that have been told to death. I find the show refreshing and cynical. The characters are very true to life and tastefully pokes fun at all the Gen Alpha stereotypes that we all are constantly being bombarded with. Give the show a watch (with an open mind and no expectations) and you'll find that you can easily binge-watch the entire season. As an added bonus, the voice actors give the characters a convincing personality and don't insult your intelligence.

title: Has a lot of potential
author: kellyfields-49087
body: I really enjoyed this show. Had a lot of great humor and the premise was unexpected and I think it was well executed. The cast was great, as well. We are big fans of the game so we were excited to watch this. It does have some more adult humor, but as a parent I enjoy that. It was perfect for my preteen and me to watch together. It's not as strong as Bobs Burgers and some other great shows, but they are definitely on to something with it. We found it to be incredibly enjoyable and I truly hope there is another season in the future.I highly recommend for fans of the game to give it a try!!!!!

title: I watched two episodes of Exploding Kittens and I don't need to watch more...
author: shomy035-141-94948
body: ...to fall in love with these series! I mean, how I missed Tom Ellis, one of my favorite actors out there, with his Lucifer epitome playing as Lucifer Morningstar himself. Now, how the tables have turned and he voices God... or Godcat to be specific. Such a talented actor! I am a fan of the adult animation genre and Exploding Kittens was in my radar for quite some time now ever since announced and ever since it was known that Tom Ellis would be starring. And so far it doesn't disappoint at all. It's fun as hell (no pun intended lol) to watch!Highly recommend it!PS. Dear Netflix, don't you even dare cancelling it, better start planning for a season two! We want more Tom Ellis!!

title: Overall Disappointing
author: gregkogut
body: The Oatmeal cartoons are true art - each carefully crafted, all good, sometimes approaching the truly wonderful.I was eagerly anticipating this series. But I don't think I can watch past the second episode. The edgier humor is blunted, and it also somehow lacks the occasional poignant warmth and human insight that comes from the cartoons as well. It just feels sort of empty. And the writing and visuals only delivered a few good moments in the first two episodes. It comes off mostly as low-quality sarcasm rather than quality humor or commentary on deeper issues with the human condition.I'll continue to be a huge fan of the cartoon and the games.

title: The most superficial irreverence.
author: xorchid-85969
body: Groupthink "irreverence". So hard to watch. Another show that wants to tell you how to think in the clumsiest ways possible, or simply let you sit comfortably in your echo chamber. Another one. Jam pack loaded with the coolest references. You know you're cool if you get these references. You know you are living right and have the right morals. Or, at least you know your mind is not one of the dangerous ones this show pretends to come from. One show like this dies, and another one pops up in its place. A never-ending parade of borderline propaganda disguised as irreverent. This is what edgy looks like when the root source of its truths are sociopolitical and corporate sponsored.

title: This show made me mad
author: tomcohen-86310
body: While the first episode was already problematic it did give me some hope, only to be completey crushed in the followings ones.The exploding kittens game is a silly gave about well...explosions and kittens.This show takes the names and brand of this silly yet memorable card game and spits on it.Nothing in the show is related to the game, there is not enough explosions or kittens for a show named exploding kittens.This show is about family values and sometimes focuses on the family that adopted godcat more then godcat himself.The humor is overdone and not new, the animation is nice, the voice acting is really good. The script is so bad i almost puked rainbows out of my catbutt.I just dont understand how you can take a good concept and ruin it so bad? This show could have been amazing if focusing on the atmosphere of the card game.I dont recommend this show at all and am very disappointed by its producers. Like always netflix knows how to disappoint well.

title: Not for me
author: heavymetalpretzel
body: I have followed The Oatmeal for years on social media and I love their beautifully unhinged style. However, I have to be honest this cartoon was not for me. I just didn't find it particularly funny which is odd because their other online content is hilarious. I think the story is really original and to be honest it was refreshing to see something totally different. I think it's incredible what they have achieved though getting a show on Netflix and some of the other reviews are way too harsh and unnecessary. It's a cartoon about a cat God folks, it's really not that deep 😅. If you don't like it go watch something else...

title: Beautiful and heartbreaking
author: cindyshea-80141
body: This story will make your heart hurt and you will feel like you know this family. As many times as I have read or seen WW11 stories, it still blows my mind all of this happened to human beings. This show makes you connect to each character. One story line that is beautifully and heartbreakingly done is the mother/daughter story. Parts of the episodes are difficult to watch but you need to because it happened and this show does a good job of showing the horror of early wartime in Poland. I am not done with the series yet but look forward to each episode. If this is your history genre, watch and read the book.

title: Great start!
author: aarmsbury-47457
body: I don't understand any of the negative reviews!Only four episodes so far...but I am extremely captivated by this show. Some characters are a bit more likeable or more interesting than others, but I think the character development is solid so far.The storylines so far are interesting and definitely keeping me wanting to keep watching. I appreciate each family member's unique storyline and seeing where everyone ends up.Someone commented that the accents are fake, but I disagree. I think the actors are phenomenal and it seems most of them are actually Jewish which gives this show some extra authenticity points.I think this show has great momentum and I'm very upset I can't watch the remaining 4! I want to binge the rest of this. Please give this a chance and don't listen to the low reviews!

title: Lesser portrayed aspects of the late 1930s and WWII
author: chambernairn
body: I watched this show within 2 days, at least the first episodes that anre available. I don't think the other reviewer did. First, it's not a movie. Second, because by the point of the most recent episode we have barely gotten to 1941.The show covers lesser known stories during WWII like Russian Siberian work camps (so many political prisoners and their families died due to harsh conditions in these camps) as well as the plight of European Jews attempting to sail to another continent.Lastly, it's actually about Jewish people. The protagonists are Jewish and not some white savior. And the protagonists are acted by Jewish people. It seems the other reviewer found all of this somehow intolerable, as it's not the norm.The show is pretty good. I will finish it when the rest of the episodes come out. Logan Lerman fell off my radar after the blockbusters of his early career but I was pleasantly surprised to see him and King fill their roles.

title: Excellent
author: carolyn-lazar
body: As a Jew I find this series to be astonishingly good and difficult to watch. The director only chose Jewish actors for the main roles which is significant. When I watch or read anything about the Holocaust I feel it in my bones. The book it is based on was written by the great-granddaughter of Nechuma and Sol. I know any Jewish actor playing a role in a script about the Holocaust would not be acting....they would be thinking it could have been them and still might be. Anti-Semitism is the oldest hatred in the world dating back 2000 years. The story is a biography about a real family that managed to survive intact. That is a miracle. A must see in my opinion.

title: Excellent series
author: john-75361
body: The only negative I can say is that in the first episode it's a bit tricky to figure out who all the characters are. I simply rewatched the 1st episode again.Otherwise this is an excellent series. I agree with other user comments...if you think the events in the film are overblown or overly dramatic, read up on your history. To the contrary, even the most wrenching scenes were depicted in a measured manner, especially considering the reality of that time and place.For those of us who are history buffs and think we've seen it all when it comes to WWII films, this film offers a unique perspective of one family's plight, and the plot takes curious twists and turns that are both surprising and gripping.

title: Captivating
author: tmoeggy
body: This show is well done! The cast is great, the acting is fabulous and anyone that says it is boring and the story is "overdone", should consider picking up a history book and get outside their own mind for a change. The persecution of the Jewish people was and is horrendous. To say they were the "lucky ones" is sad; they still lived through something none of us in today's world, can imagine! I can't wait for the rest of the episodes! I have put the book on my want to read list. I imagine it is even better than this show, as most books are. God bless the Jewish people. They have suffered enough, for all of humanity.

title: Absolutely captivating
author: engrbu
body: I liked the fact that the action does not start suddenly, like most series. I like the characters, I like the graphics, I like the script. I can't wait for the next episodes!!From this first episode it captivated me. I think it is so necessary especially in the days we live in when people hate each other based on ethnic criteria. This film tries to show us, indirectly, the totally negative effects of this hatred.I've read the book the series is based on and it really respects a lot of things from there, but the series captivates you even more.The filming locations also look like they are right out of this story. As if the events happened right there. I love this!

title: Great, but got me lost sometimes
author: petalaugusto
body: This is an amazing series, with great actors delivering solid performances. The story is more than what we are used to see, because it shows details from daily life during the second world war that are not common to see. Also, it is nice to see the resistance and how it worked. My only reason for not giving a bigger rate was the sense that I was lost every time. It felt to me as a screenplay problem, that damaged the continuity and got me distracted sometimes. It think it was hard to portrait so much different places and timelines at the same time.But, although I only gave 7, this doesn't take away the greatness of the series. A must for those who are willing to understand how things worked back then.

title: Unveiling Grace: A Riveting Journey with a Stellar Cast
author: vladdubchak
body: "Watching 'We Were the Lucky Ones' (2024) felt like a journey back in time, echoing the stories of my own family and many others from my childhood community. This mini-series doesn't just recount another story set against the grim backdrop of WW2 in Poland and the USSR; it delves deep into the harrowing, yet resilient spirit of Jewish families navigating through unimaginable hardships. The authenticity and emotional depth of the narrative, coupled with an amazing cast, brought these stories to life in a way that's both haunting and inspiring. It's rare to find a series that captures the essence of such a pivotal time in history with such honesty and respect. 'We Were the Lucky Ones' is truly a masterpiece that resonates with me on a profoundly personal level."

title: Pretty enjoyable, very smooth!
author: UniqueParticle
body: Episode 1 is tricky like someone else said there's not much introduction to the characters a little unsettling yet very well filmed and I enjoy several of the cast in many projects so that helps. My mom recommended this it's lovely, basically a love story in holocaust settings even though the based genre is drama seems more than that. I like that this is highly rated that's always nice to see! I loved learning about World War II in school back in the day it seems there's loads of stories about it since most of which are really well made. I've enjoyed Joey King and Logan Lerman for at least a decade they are wonderful in anything fairly young too I hope they get awards in their career!

title: Very good drama
author: archiehyde-27714
body:
I do not understand why there are any reviewers who claim that this covers the usual ground. Apart from the fact their are millions of stories of suffering during the Holocaust, this particular family had a very unique experience and the series gives insight into the less common fates from Polish Jews during WW2..
More than ever now, we should be reminding ourselves of the uniquely terrible experience of Jews and other victims of Nazism & Facists during the war.I agree the accents could be a bit distracting, but the acting was very good. The series does take a couple episodes to find its rhythm but it quickly becomes compelling and I binged the whole thing over the weekend.I would definitely reccommend this. My only complaint is that the rviwe has to be so long.I would also reccommend visting the Shoah Foundation Youtube channel for first person accounts of survivors of the Holocaust; each story truly extraordinary and important.

title: After reading the book, it still doesn't disappoint
author: jamiebezdek
body: This mini series is based off a book and is the true story of Jewish adult siblings, their parents and spouses, and the variety of real paths their lives take as WWII unfolds. The book is written by a member of the family. Many siblings go paths I knew nothing about or aren't commonly talked about. Once books turn to film, they often disappoint, but not this one. It's engaging, inspiring, and unimaginable. I am excited for future episodes. My husband, who has not read the book, is equally engaged. The acting and story line are top notch. We must never forget these are really people who went through these atrocities.

title: Absolutely superb!
author: tovelise
body: This is one of the very best series I have ever seen, and it is a true story as told in a book by a direct descendant of this family. The writing, the acting, the cinematography, the intricate weaving of the interconnected threads of people's lives - all is carefully crafted to draw you in to the horror of the Nazi regime as well as the resiliency of these people and the strength they derived from their families and their cultural and spiritual traditions. After following the horrendous hardships and torments they endured through seven episodes and seven years of their lives, how could I help but weep through the last one? My tears flowed freely. The real-life Kurc family photos were the perfect ending. An amazing story told amazingly well. Wow. Just wow.

title: solid series
author: nerrdrage
body: Four episodes in, and every one is a consistent 8/10. Not great art, a little hokey, but the compulsive gotta-see-what-happens-next factor is very strong with this one.The cast is mostly unknowns and surprisingly strong. I particularly like Moran Rosenblatt as Herta, the kind of tough cookie who can survive anything.Logan Lerman as the Parisian sophisticate Addy is also very good. He looks like someone who could have been an actor in the 1940s. Reminds me of Tyrone Power in his glory days, has a lot of the same angsty energy.I always like seeing attention to detail in historical stories to avoid anachronisms. Seeing someone in the streets of Paris wearing a WWI era gas mask wouldn't have been surprising. They would think the last war would pose the same dangers as the coming one.When Addy plays "Puttin' on the Ritz," the lyrics are from the original version, about Harlem. A sloppier show would have used the more well known lyrics that were written for a post-war Astaire film. Nice job on research there.It's a good thing Hulu is doling this out weekly. Otherwise I'd just binge watch the whole thing in one weekend.

title: Wow. Just WOW
author: MovieswDan
body: We Where the Lucky Ones is now streaming all episodes on Hulu. This true story about one family's experiences trying to survive Nazi occupied Poland consists of an entirely Jewish cast lead by Joey King and Logan Lerman. It is based on the book of the same name by Georgia Hunter and was created by Erica Lipez, who previously worked as a writer on Suits, Bates Motel, and The Morning Show.This show sucked me in from the first episode. The way this show was written was so captivating that I found it hard to wait each week for a new episode to drop. The name of the show is We Were the Lucky Ones, and the tagline reads "inspired by one family's true story of survival" so viewers can assume that all or at least most of the family members survive. This knowledge did nothing to make this show less suspenseful or keep me from being on the edge of my seat scene after scene. All I kept thinking was "I cannot believe they survived this" and "how the hell do they survive this?"The show not only highlights the family's survival but also does a great job of educating the viewer on the world's darkest period. Shows and movies that center around the Holocaust are extremely important and need to continue to be produced, especially now where we have seen a disgustingly high increase in antisemitic incidents since last year (361% according to CNN). The more we learn about this, the less likely it is that history will repeat itself.Thank you for reading!

title: Pleasantly surprised
author: mackenziea-10070
body: I'll admit I was skeptical durning the first episode and when I saw Joey king. Now I'm not a Joey king hater, in fact I've enjoyed most of her projects since she was a child. With that said I was worried she would come off too unserious and maybe she wouldn't have the depth for the role. After finishing this series I'm happy to say she definitely grew with and into this role. The first episode is meant to be lighthearted and set the scene of this predominant Jewish family in Poland right before the holocaust. So her acting that I was skeptical about then fits with the story being told. As for the series overall, it's just absolutely beautiful (as much as it can be considering the content matter). The fact that this is a real story of a family who faced this extremely horrific reality still blows my mind especially how it all ended up. If you have been considering watching this or even if you started it and turned it off give it a real chance. I was teary eyed during the last episode. As I sit and reflect on the work of art I just consumed I can say I would watch this again and recommend it to anyone I can. The biggest thing that makes me amazed is that the author of the book whose family this is never knew about the past her family endured until she was later on in life. She came across her family history by chance and went on an amazing and heartbreaking journey to tell this very important story from a terrible point in history. Thank you Georgia for giving us a new view of history.

title: Just genuinely uninteresting...
author: JabezGill
body: We've seen this movie 100 times before - Jewish Europeans try to survive the Holocaust. They start off naive of the threat of Nazi Germany, then get a rude awakening, then do everything they can to survive.Unfortunately, the way the characters and story is portrayed in this particular series is just uninspiring. It has struggled to keep my attention, struggled to make me connect with/care for the specific characters (beyond the obvious care/connection you feel for the real, historical people that suffered through these events).The script is weak at times, the actor chemistry is off, the show just seems very flat through the first few episodes. Inconsistent acting quality... hope this improves, I will gladly change my review if it doesThat is such a shame since the show says this is a "true story."

title: Binge-worthy
author: teribialosky
body: Watched the first 3 episodes the day they dropped. Many of the actors are from other series I've enjoyed so that inspired me to watch. It is hard knowing their plight, but the characters are developing well. Not sure why they're all speaking English knowing it should be with subtitles but small criticism. Worth watching for sure. Of course, hoping there's more "Kive & Libby" in the series. In fact, why is Michael Aloni not listed on the cast? It definitely has different storylines than most Holocaust centric films. There's a somewhat slow build that is part of the show's intrigue. Hoping they all make it.

title: Heartbreaking
author: mizkj
body: I watched all 4 episodes available so far. I was hooked after meeting the family in episode one. I found the characters to be interesting and the acting to be very believeable. The stories of each family member are different in interesting ways. The chemistry between characters is good. I am glad the actors are Jewish as some others have mentioned. But I am glad they are speaking English because I don't enjoy reading subtitles - I miss too much of the facial expressions and it really detracts from my enjoyment. As for the subject matter, I cannot imagine surviving an experience such as the Jews of the time did. It is horrifying and hopeful all at the same time. I'm looking forward to the rest of the story.

title: Does humanity learn from history?
author: Andu007
body:
I came across this as I do like a true story or a film/series based on a true story, WW2 being an era that I like to hear about personal experiences.I've just watched the final episode (8th) & only now do I think it's fair to leave a review.I really enjoyed it & I got to know the characters & felt I was a part of their perilous journey during the dark times of Europe in the 30s & the war.The Poles having a hard time not only with the Soviets but then the Nazis & if you were a Jew, then worse.I've not really watched similar series, so I can't compare it but only review it on its own merit.To think that there were many that suffered & this is just one story of a family & what they bravely endured.It's harrowing & horrific in places, joyous & tearful joy in others.It shows both sides of humanity, good & evil.I didn't binge watch, I had to wait a week before the next episode was released but I needed to know what happened next & watched it immediately
To think this all happened in relatively recent times is an awful thought.Has humanity learnt?!

title: A Must Watch
author: marylynn_hilton
body: I've watched many many Holocaust films and this is another must watch. I've been to Poland and went to Auschwitz and walked through the cells, the gas chamber, viewed all of the goods that the Germans took from the Jewish people. I've toured many Holocaust museums. These stories must be told. I wish more families would tell their stories. We must never forget the atrocities the Jewish people endured. Or someday it will happen again. It is so hard to imagine how anyone can be so evil. But it's a slow fade and propaganda works on those who are ignorant and do not seek truth.The story line was well done and the acting was superb.

title: Fantastic. Devastating, heartbreaking, and then heartwarming
author: libbysparks-99799
body: This show has affected me more than anything I have ever watched. I was absolutely gripped and immersed throughout the entire show. Every episode was heavy on my heart for days after watching. I watched it as each episode came out and I am grateful for that because I needed many breaks for my mental health. It's a difficult watch, but worth it. It's a fresh take on the history of Poland during World War II. So often, media about the holocaust is about people who didn't live to tell their stories and the "white saviors" who experienced it secondhand. This is a jewish cast of jewish characters based on a book from actual jewish people who lived to tell their stories. I think that's what makes it so impactful. This show also does a stellar job at portraying the process of the persecution of jewish people from the beginning of the occupation of Poland to its liberation. The acting is overall very good, with several standout performances. I am very glad I decided to watch this show that does not shy away from the reality of the holocaust but is able to show the power of hope in the darkest of times. This is a beautiful piece of art about a harrowing true story.

title: Great series
author: emma-allen1
body: I thoroughly enjoyed this series. I've cried and watched anxiously through each episode.It gave me hope, sadness and a greater understanding of what it would have been like from a family perspective. Plus also learning how many different directions each family member took, either on purpose or accidental, was interesting.At first I was put off by some of the actors/actresses fake accents, however moving past that and focusing on the story to tell.. I was roped in immediately. By using some well known actors and then lesser ones also really helped.Only downside was that I had to wait each week until the new episode got released.

title: Not bad, but not good?
author: lobsterindc
body: The series has a great cast but something is missing. Better writing? More character development? I'm not sure.I'm great at putting my phone down when watching a show, but this series is failing to hold my attention - which given the subject matter should be instantly.I recognized quite a few of the actors and have liked them individually in other films but the lack of character development in this series makes it hard to fully immerse myself in their situation and empathize with them.As another review mentioned, it's possible because I've seen this story many times before and it's been written, directed, and/or acted much better.

title: a reminder of power of community
author: benkarge
body:
It's a big story to tell and the capturing of it through this many characters is hard to keep track of at times. I don't feel particularly connected to any of them but considering we are actively
living through a genocide of people i can't emphasize enough how important it is we learn, we watch, we listen to stories of genocide and oppressed people now more than ever. They had community they had to speak with each other we don't even have to know our neighbors today and most of us live in countries with heavy military presence where this occurrence could happen quickly and easily. Hold tight to each other is the story being told because facism and supremacy is swift cruel and deadly. Now is the time to consider what side of history you will be on and this show is a painful reminder that it is an active choice to fight and advocate against such violent forces.

title: Absolutely excellent, possibly even better than the book.
author: yaellock
body:
My only possible criticism is that the war ends so suddenly. It's never clear if Caroline is Jewish or not. But it's an amazing show that is faithful to the based- on- a- true- story novel and absolutely an important watch. Especially now, with senseless antisemitism and hatred once again rearing its ugly head. I love the usage of Jewish actors for Jewish characters. The story depicts characters who are not Orthodox Jews but they are traditional. I think it is important for the non- informed viewer to know that. Family is very important to them and their Lo
Be gets them through the gehinnom of World War 2.

title: Simply wonderful
author: Gav-7
body: A great story delivered by a talented cast. It's both heartbreaking and heart warming. The story is set during the war with a Jewish family separated and trying to survive the threat of Nazi Germany.The actors are very well cast in their roles and are so talented and believable. I loved Logan Lerman he was such a revelation in this role. He made the character so loveable. The cinematography is beautiful too the streets and the sets look so authentic. If you have to watch one holocaust story please watch this one . It will break your hear and warm your heart in equal measure. I cried tears of happiness at the end. A must watch.

title: Beautifully honest
author: sewgemma
body: I've always educated myself about the crimes that happened during WW2, however, this series really brings all the atrocities, desperation of the Jewish people, and personal sacrifice. It's shocking and heartbreaking whilst being insightful.It makes you question what you would have done to survive and if you would have been smart and brave enough to do what you needed to do to secure your safety.It's a beautiful story of a families different paths to survival and how they individually deal with the consistent and devastating changes and evolution of the escalating war around them whilst being hunted for slavery and to extinction.

title: A Well Done True Story
author: sheridaglover
body: The Kurcs are a loving, successful, Jewish family in Poland in the late 1930's. Seemingly overnight, their world turned upside down. They find themselves split all over the globe, always trying to find each other.Led by Joey King, the immensely talented cast portray the pain and terror inflicted on them by various governments and the quiet heroism they show under stress.For older kids (maybe 12 and up) this would be a great series to watch and study. Bringing this dark time in history to young people's eyes through this real life family would be a strong start to studying this important era.I watched it one episode per week, and rewatched it binge-style with my hubby one cold weekend. Binge-style is better. There are a few episodes that end on cliffhangers that left me seriously stressed.All in all, this is a wonderfully produced, directed and acted series.

title: Yawn
author: cstratton-225-879772
body: Without question the subject should be told over and over again (keeping the promise to never forget) so that younger generations know what happened. But there's very little that's original here in HOW this particular story is told. We've seen this version before. Many times. Over-wrought, over-written - it feels like an old school, network movie of the week. For stronger, more human options with dimension - EUROPA, EUROPA comes to mind. Or A SMALL LIGHT. THE PIANIST. SCHINDLER'S LIST...not all of which are limited series of course but have characters that are complicated, distinct, and compelling.

title: Show Title perfect description of show's uniqueness
author: jkylehurt
body: I am intrigued how a show about European Jews in WW2 made me extremely nervous and emotional all while being about hope. This extended family could be any family. I think the writers purposely left out first person views of concentration camps to humanize polish Jews and show the endless struggle to survive with family members in different situations. We Were the Lucky Ones demonstrates the complexity and decision making of the members of a once cohesive family and allows us to view their reactions under individual pressures and desires. A lot of television shows us how a person can be viewed as strong and moral under normal circumstances but deviate when life is threatened. However, We Were the Lucky Ones shows us how it's possible not to notice another's strength under normal conditions, but then fall in love with their courageous resistance to madness.

title: Heartbreaking and heartwarming and wonderful acting
author: chezwoof
body: I absolutely loved the series, it was interesting right from the beginning, I often lose interest by the second or third episode and this series had me binging the entire thing and in a single evening! Even though I had to get up early the next morning, I just couldn't stop watching it.All the actors did a wonderful job, I found the flow of the timeline quite easy to follow, and it was very realistic, and it's the first time I see a show that shows all the different ways that the Jewish population was stopped from trying to escape.
