Alien.I was a bit skeptical going into this docuseries, hoping there would be new information introduced, but it's the same recycled UFO information that has already been made public.This should have been on discovery channel, as it joins the ranks of any other staged show meant to draw the audience in thinking something may actually happen.... It doesn't.

title: Please do more solo stuff like this George!
author: mkd-16330
body: FINALLY I CAN ENJOY QUALITY UFO JOURNALISM WITHOUT HAVING TO LISTEN TO JEREMY CORBELL JACK HIMSELF OFF THE WHOLE TIME YESSSSSSSSSSS!!!!!! This was my favorite ufo documentary in recent years. George asks all the right questions and provides some really interesting evidence. There's only one scene with Jeremy Corbell and this was the best choice ever. The only reason I've ever payed any attention to Corbell is because of Knapp. Taking one star away because I kind of wish it was just George the whole time and not CIA guy and pilot lady also interviewing witnesses. They're much more tolerable than corbel but I felt like they were just there to be skeptical of lies from witnesses rather than ask good questions. Having a skeptic point of view is great but no reason to have cast for that. I think if was just George addressing common skeptic points it would've been perfect. Replacing them with any other respected ufologst like George could've worked better too. George you can tell is a genuine guy and has been an amazing journalist his whole life. I'm so happy we got this treat and I really hope we get another season.

title: Feels as scripted as Pawn Stars
author: pappamea
body: Feels like a generic scripted American show, like Pawn Stars. Doesn't feel genuine at all and there's really nothing new they're adding.It's more like they're dragging it out, trying to find someone who can add a little drama to fill their thin script.George is trying so hard to sell this, but what new info are we really getting?Every bit of information we get has already been talked about, you're better off going in the deep end on YouTube instead.I don't really have much more to say about this utter horse manure, so I'm just filling up the required quota of words, just like they did with this show.

title: Overly scripted which undermines calling it "investigative reporting"
author: Scotslad_007
body: I'm interested in this topic when it is not overly sensationalized, and there are many previously shows that are way over the top. Over the top in terms on how it is narrated and also is just showing very weak evidence but taking leaps in logic. So it gets a 5 star for a massive improvement in how it was presented relative to others.I didn't like the parts of the show when meeting experts or eye witnesses at the side of roads, parking lots, etc. Getting out of the car and just start talking about it, it's like they were not taking this seriously. Possibly they didn't have a budget for a studio.The first episode of animal mutilation I found interesting as they show some real mysteries. I also like that folks refrained from attempting to fill in the blank but providing just the facts.On the other hand the underwater scan with non-human shapes really was a stretch and no investigative questions were asked. Often it felt that during the interviews that Knapp was looking for his own validation and not being objective in asking the hard questions.I didn't like the AARO counter report, the attempt to find solid information was a complete miss. We already have the information, I think the Phoenix Lights itself is more than enough. Witnessed by thousands, what is needed is acknowledgement that something happened that was far, far superior to our current understanding and capability.Overall the series was OK but due to lack of budget I assume, it needed better experts, better places to interview people (not outside your car) and less speculation and more facts.

title: Super average
author: muuuvo
body: The host and his offshoots spend about 70% of the time telling the audience what they plan to do and what they're hoping to do or see. It's just pointless filler and gives the feel of a bubblegum documentary that makes the whole thing feel fake.Despite the underlying information likely being good, this completely misses the mark and could have been presented so much better. The American approach to documentaries is just too emotional and comes across as a reality TV show.Would love to see NatGeo or a non-sensationalist journalist take this on. George Knapp ruins it and seems fixated on creating sensationalist mystique rather than objectively presenting. This is the American way.Very disappointing.

title: Pretty awful
author: greysky72
body: I appreciate Knapp and what he's trying to do but this was awful. I didn't like the 'feel' of the show at all, felt forced, overly scripted and sometimes really disingenuous. I don't think they brought forward any new information or proof. They definitely didn't solve anything and even had me rolling my eyes a few times on some 'evidence' they brought forward that was just ridiculous. Don't get me wrong, I'm a believer as I've had my own personal experiences witnessing a few UFOs over the years. Whether they were ET or government craft I couldn't say but crazy either way. Was excited when I saw this show available on Netflix but my enthusiasm died halfway through the first episode and never came back through the rest of the show.

title: I now have a lot less respect for the Peabody awards, knowing George Knapp is a recipient.
author: FONYMAHONEY
body: Now, don't get me wrong - as an avid viewer of practically every Netflix 'documentary', it's fair to say the standard is uneven and I've got zero problem with Netflix diversifying their portfolio to include History channel-level fare. Evidently, there's an audience for it. A big one.But THIS is nonsense to the point of being irresponsible. George Knapp is an utterly insufferable onscreen presence, he can't help but talk in heavy handed cliches. He's so deeply insincere and cringeworthy, he arguably made me even MORE of a skeptic.I'm open to anything, but THIS type of rubbish is why most people believe anybody claiming to have engaged with extraterrestrial life is a gullible idiot fantasist. Maybe that's the point? I doubt it - but this over-egging makes it impossible to take this even remotely seriously, and listing it as a documentary is deeply misleading. And George Knapp is an insincere and tedious conman who should have his journalistic credentials confiscated, beginning with his Peabody award (seriously, HOW?! Was it an inside joke to bestow something on the dumbest person in the business?)If you're just looking for a new, good documentary - don't waste your time. This is not a documentary. Like Jersey Shore meets Mars Attacks. Avoid.

title: This is par for Discovery ch and too produced to be classified as a documentary

body: For example, with no spoilers, when you have two story lines, two investigations if you will, made to appear to take place simultaneously so we cut back and forth between the dive team and the south American team - the viewer knows this isn't serious - when we have the investigator reinact scenes and fiegn reactions as if it's the first time he's heard this - the viewer knows this isn't a serious documentary - AND IT'S A SERIOUS SUBJECT - but Knapp has been left out in the cold for too many decades and now appears to need vindication and barring that well... title: Very vague and sensationalist
author: everything_changes-423-355263
body: Nothing new. Chewing on old stories which some of them were already debunked. For example the Arizona lights. Basically trying way too hard to push every light, every flying object to be an alien spaceship. title: Could've been a lot better
author: p-81253
body: I had high expectations for this as it was led by George Knapp, an award winning investigative journalist, who has a long track record of investigating UFO related stories.Disappointingly the Phoenix Lights sightings in 1997 were used as a lynch pin for evidence of a government cover-up. However, this has been debunked with the phenomenon being explained by two earth-bound events. This was not mentioned in the series.Therefore it brings into question the other evidence that was presented in terms of their credibility.The "jellyfish video" was very interesting, although there was no investigation into its authenticity.Other items in the series that raised some interesting thoughts were not explored further which seems a mistake.Overall entertaining but does not really overcome any skepticism regarding UFOs/UAPs/USOs.

title: Cherrypicking analysis
author: liveroc
body: All these Alien, Extraterrestrial documentaries rehash the same material and each presentation picks its ' likes' for analysis. Yet, they all start with gruesome animal mutilations, followed by human subjects. To this day, autopsy results of these animals are outstanding. That's pretty dark. Blame the aliens? Yet, the series is filled with guess work and autopsy results are outstanding. How can this be taken seriously? Are humans afraid to touch the carcass and perform an autopsy?The extraterrestrial narratives expose the aggrandizement and delusional thinking of men like Musk obsessed with the colonization of Mars, where Musk himself, most likely will never set foot on. Just like Leopold II of Belgium never set foot in the Congo. Mush has no idea how much the human body would have to change to survive such a journey. Moreover, for humans, Mars is a one way ticket. Whomever goes to Mars isn't coming back. It's dark that humans would dream of Mars while destroying Earth.Earth is home to numerous species. With different mindsets, you would achieve different intelligence and technologies. Hydrogen is the only element that has the power to travel intergalactic. It's also the cleanest form of energy. It means all the space 'gadgets' produced are much darts thrown into the dark. Non of our present day space endeavors can remotely achieve a trip to Mars, it barely reaches the moon. We can't return astronauts from the ISS in a fashionable matter, and is space debris is cluttering orbit, reflecting sunlight onto Earth with higher intensity. Reagan gave a speech in which he painted the extraterrestrials as the boogeyman. Will it take this boogeyman to stop the insanity of warfare or will warfare speed up human demise? Of course, we are not alone, it is quite arrogant to think so. Just as we can look at ants so do other lifeforms look at us. The ant is not aware of our existence. Whether it has anything to do with the content of these episodes is another matter. An advanced intelligence that proves to be our cousins by DNA must look down at us in horror and dismay. Collectively, our present day behavior is far less civil than our ancient ancestors.To publish the evidence that some extraterrestrials are simply an advanced branch of the hominid tree by millions of years would be sweet irony, a divine comedy indeed.

title: Contemplating Demonstrating
author: TheFearmakers
body: If you count how long the left-wing streaming company Netflix deals with Mike Tyson's downfall, particularly his going to jail, it lasts shorter than his early one-rounders... and you never hear the word rape, not once...Hence the liberal media has stopped/paused the cancel culture... especially if there is money to be made... as happened with the novelty fight between former world champion boxer Mike Tyson and You Tube Influencer Jake Paul...Watching Tyson's bio followed by Paul's is like comparing George Washington to a district councilman in Cleveland with a dog that has hiccups... one's genuinely historic; the other got famous for getting tons of hits from what even his own biography (this documentary) doesn't fully explain...The Ryan backers use the word "haters" when describing what/who he was up against... Haters is a term of a lot of people suddenly being against something or someone... And haters only exist in a world where someone goes from nobody to celebrity because of an overnight "viral" sensation...So basically, haters exist in a world to counter celebrities who become famous for no actual reason, which is unlike Tyson... So if haters hate for no reason, they're hating people who became famous for no actual reason... It all evens out...And if this documentary was more on Tyson and his struggles, it would be a lot better and would last longer because at this point we've already seen the Tyson/Paul cash-grab fight... this is all basically promoting something that has already happened.

title: 2 Bonus Stars for Mike
author: bpb99
body: This show is exactly as bad as you think it would be. You got a half decent documentary about Mike filled with absolute BS from Jake Paul.On the one side you got the legend Mike Tyson, being Mike.Then it's got Jake Paul, talking all sorts of nonsense. Every single thing he says is so cringe, so dumb or so wrong. He looks awful, hasn't fought a real opponent. They glaze over this in the show but then show him beating punch drunk UFC fighters. Guys who were done in the UFC already. Ben Askrenn?? You got to be jokingWhen showing the Paul backstory they totally to include the clip where he forced underaged girls to make out with his dad (multiple times)

title: Just a fun romp
author: rlwyattcali
body: I gave it a7 measured against everything I've ever watched before. The short review is that I enjoyed this. I binge watched it during my wife's absence because I suspected she would not enjoy it. My taste is slightly more eclectic and so I came into this without major expectations, simply expecting just a fun romp with the occasional smart or funny quip and it met my expectation.I read through many of these reviews before and after watching and I think some viewers expected too much. If a person feels the need to write a horrible review, why the heck even would that individual hang in there for eight episodes?Anyway, if you are the curious type, you'll see I have a public list of movies I've watched during my many years on this little blue planet. I don't write a lot of reviews but jumped in here because I felt this deserved higher than a six rating. If you've found my review and you're wondering if you should invest 8 hours of your time watching this, my advice would be to stay away if you are the very serious or overly critical type.It was fun. Love has long claws.

title: Enjoyable!
author: inspektorr
body: I think many have a lack of understanding what satire is. If you need a laugh track to have fun, this is not for you. I found the storytelling to be pretty smart and every episode is filled with twists and turns that keep the story interesting.Obviously, this isn't historically accurate. It doesn't need to be and doesn't try to be, if somehow soundtrack made of 80's electro pop and punk hasn't made it abundantly clear already.It's a study of humanity and well - inhumanity. The setting is irrelevant. It could've just as easily been placed in modern time. It's not like we haven't gone through a pandemic recently...Anyways, personally I've enjoyed it. And you may as well. That is if you don't find it infuriating that characters are wearing wrong gowns, or speak English with an accent that you don't like, or whatever the negative critics say.

title: Fun take on selfishness and ambition
author: ana-brigovic
body: It is good. Looks great. Has great actors. Uses satire and the period of the black plague both as wrappings in which to serve some smart portrayals of human greed, selfishness, inequality (which is still terrible today) and position of women and lgbt persons (also current issues). It is hard to look at this mirror to humans evwn with the bows silly hats and bright colors that is served with.I found it an easy watch. Amusing. And occasionally clever and funny. But mostly was glued to the actors who are all quite successfully playing not particulary likeable characters.And the show really does look very good!I am surprised it is on netflix. Feels like it would fit better with hbo.

title: More "Canterbury Tales" than "The Decameron"?
author: fionalk-22873
body: There is no point in comparing this with Boccaccio's Decameron, as it has only really taken the idea and setting from Boccaccio. This is not setting out to be a serious adaption and is best not judged as such. The tone and humour may seem more in line with Boccaccio's contemporary Chaucer and The Canterbury Tales.The humour is broad, but does hit the mark on occassions and the setting and costumes are certainly beautiful. The show features an international cast of well-known faces from some top comedy titles who cope well with the stye which is at times positively theatrical.Just taken as a stand-alone production, separated from its illustrious literary predecessor, it has quite a lot to offer those just seeking entertaintainment who may have little interest in history or satire.

title: Fun, Shakespearean type of comedy
author: vvdjena
body: I am not sure why the show got such low grades. It has all it takes to make it interesting to watch: light humour, fast pace, caracter development, awkward situations... I mean yes, there is no end goal to it, as in there is no classic scenario, some things are bizzare and maybe illogical, but it all serves the atmosphere of a plague, and depicting the sense that the people must have had during those times - despair, hunger, pain, opportunism, but also sense of freedom, unimportance of social status, changing roles, and finally importance of love and friendship during difficult times.The show depicts how in times of crisis people start behaving in different ways, and the results are sometimes bizzare, sometimes satisfactory.Though not really a Decameron, it reminded me of Shakespeare's comedy plays, depicting quircky medival atmosphere. It definitely deserves higher grades.

title: Watchable
author: ballitup-43518
body: It's a very watchable show. Not great but not terrible. It would have been way better as a 30 min per episode comedy instead of the overly ambitious 45 min episode "dramedy" it apparently attempted. The funny moments are solid but lost between long periods are dullness and scenes that tend to last too long. The "drama" falls flat in the wake of silliness and yet it's the so called serious moments that fill most of the time. I really like the concept of this time period and how people might have reacted during the chaos but I think the execution is lacking in this one. That being said, there are some solid performances by the cast.

title: Fake Dekameron
author: nzbmgpuxk-33213
body: This series has nothing to do with the original work. It's just an unassuming soap opera dipped in medieval costumes in the netflix style. Childish jokes, meaningless, drawn-out storytelling. The costumes, the scenery, the photography are fine, but it has as much to do with the Decameron as Inspector Drebin has to do with the opera. Nothing. I still had hope for the first episodes, but I realized that netflix only needed a good-sounding title to create something mediocre and forgettable again. It's unfortunate, because the Decameron could have been excellently developed, see the Pasolini film.

title: Absolutely brilliant and well-played
author: anganglaz
body: I'm so happy I saw the positive reviews and gave this a go. It's actually brilliant, well-played and so funny, I found myself laughing out loud several times. I have to admit I was a bit skeptical at the beginning of the first episode, but found myself quickly drawn into the story. It's crazy, clever and highly entertaining, with many surprise twists and turns which keeps you completely invested in the story and characters. The actors are playing their roles almost to perfection, capturing the stupidity of their character with what feels like such a natural ease. I cannot understand the negative reviews AT all! I loved this.

title: Careless fun and nothing more
author: taroomen
body: Just a fun show to watch in my opinion.For historically accurate series, you might want to watch a documentary. This is very much not that.I had a good laugh while watching this, knowing to not take it seriously.Between all the current affairs and also the real documentaries that I watch, this show was a very welcome distraction.Yes, it is simple humour and easy to follow, but that doesn't necessarily make it bad.I feel the actors are all committed to their parts and make the best of the script they have. And they look to me like they are having good fun at it too. I don't think there's anything wrong with that! There are plenty of serious works out there. Avoid this if you are looking for that.

title: Relax and enjoy yourself!!
author: ncspeeddiva
body: My goodness but doesn't anyone want to watch something just for fun anymore?? C'mon y'all, this is called humor and we need it these days.First I want to thank the sound crew for the delicious soundtrack! I'm in my mid 50s and most of the songs (I've watched the first 4 episodes so far) have me and my husband nearly dancing while viewing!! Of course it's silly to hear Depeche Mode playing in the background during a scene from the 1300s, but that's the point! Some of these other reviewers seem to have missed the point.This series is very refreshing, goofy, fun and hilarious but also well scripted, performed and beautiful cinematography as well. I am trying not to binge this one out too quickly, yet I can't wait for more!!!

title: WILD!
author: Laqshayaroraofficial
body:
Just finished watching all the episodes, and here's my review:Positives:
A super crazy, binge-worthy historical drama. When I saw that the first episode was about an hour long, I almost wanted to quit. But not a single scene was boring, and the same goes for the rest of the episodes. The show is highly entertaining with very few slow scenes that won't ruin your experience. After the first episode, I stopped checking the duration because I was enjoying it. The direction, the writing, the cast, the background music, the location, and the story all of it worked well.No character is safe in this show, which I love. I enjoy shows where they kill off some or many lead characters because it keeps you engaged and interested in seeing who will survive until the end.The cast did an amazing job. I love many of the characters, especially Filomena and Neifile, who were my favorites. Even though it's currently a limited series, I'd love for the show to continue for at least three seasons or more..The final episode includes a really dark scene that I wasn't expecting. The overall ending was superb and satisfying, avoiding the usual cliffhanger tactic to force a network renewal.The ratings are currently a bit low, but please give it atleast 10-15 minutes of your time before judging the show based on these ratings and skipping it.Negatives:
Although I don't mind nudity and intimate scenes, some of it felt a bit unnecessary. Almost everyone is involved, including straight people, gays, lesbians, and even rats in the intro. But, this doesn't impact the overall experience much.The final battle could have been more interesting and thrilling, keeping us on the edge. Instead, it was made more casual.They could have explored the black deaths happening during the pandemic a bit more. The show mainly focuses on those who are not affected, so it doesn't feel like it's set during a pandemic. The focus is more on, poisonous deaths, revenge, and battle rather than the disease.Overall: This is a must-watch and super binge-worthy show. I hope it gets the hype it deserves, with popular leads from hit shows like Sex Education and Derry Girls. It's on Netflix and is one of the best comedy period dramas. It may not be as good as The Great, but fans of that show might also enjoy this one. Rating: 3.75/5.

title: Beautifully shot
author: niclisem
body: Well as I said its beautifully shot and thats about it. It's just not well....funny. The script is very poor. If any of you listen to Mrak Kermode and Simon Mayos podcast Mark states for a film to be funny it has to past the 3 laugh test, this at a run length of 1 hour for the 1st episode didn't even give me a chance to smirk let alone laugh. It is without doubt one of the worst comedies I've seen. Perhaps it gets better, but sorry it's just not doing it for me and I won't be investing my time in another episode.This is just my own opinion you may find it funny and it's the show for you, but it's definitely not for me.

title: Fun romp - don't over think it
author: lpatrick-88280
body: The trailer didn't win me over so my expectations weren't high. My partner started watching it, so I joined him and we binged it through. I enjoyed it.There's plenty of dark and serious stuff out there, or American style humour, which definitely doesn't float our boat, so it's a relief to find something light and fun, that doesn't make you feel a sicker about the state of the world. And a few laugh-out-loud moments is definitely a bonus.Yes the plot might drag on a bit but I think that's the nature of tv series. It may not go down as an acclaimed masterpiece but I felt touches of Monty Python, Killing Eve and Taming of the Shrew coming through, which worked for me.

title: Absurd brilliance
author: stueyjrichards
body: The cast is fantastic and it descends into wonderful chaos. Just think of a Carry On series for a contemporary audience but without the jokes that haven't aged well. Gary Hale, Tanya Reynolds and Saoirse-Monica Jackson are standouts though the Tindaro character becomes irritating very quickly. I loved the queerness that develops and the opening credit sequence is brilliant.I must admit, I was unsure of the first episode as it took me an episode to get into the humour. The series reminds me of Our Flag Means Death in that regard. If you are unsure of the first episode, go with it and the style of humour will make sense.

title: Quirky, fun, and absurd
author: euro_xo
body: If you're looking for a bingeable, lighthearted show, give this a go. Granted, it's not quality storytelling or character development, but it's a short series and it's a fun watch. Set in the context of the Black Death, a motley crew come together in a fancy villa to try to escape their woes. Strong personalities clash as the group of misfits realize they've got way more than they've bargained for. In all truth, coming in without any expectations, Decameron was an entertaining watch! The shenanigans that the group must face, and the randomness of events, make you keep watching throughout the absurdity of it all.

title: A plague riddled pustule of a production
author: matthewbyrne-96183
body: I was hopeful for this new version. And the costumes, set and camerawork are all on-point.I wasn't expecting anything approaching Pasolini's standards but am disappointed that the way this production is presented with the same values as Bridgerton, aimed at the same audience.It is a cheap pastiche made palatable to a mass market by filling the script with slap-stick gags and nods to modernity, at the expense of deftly exploring the human condition, which is what justifies the book's masterpiece status and why it is worth bringing to our screens in the first place.The writers had the opportunity to give the audience something they didn't know they wanted but they took the easy route and gave them what they've always had.

title: I thought it was funny and weird
author: randlesjm
body: It's getting a lot of hate but I rather enjoyed it. It's funny and weird and even a little sexy. It's a crazy story of wealth and their servants moving in together in a large villa in hopes to escape the plague. Every character is delightfully awful, minus one that is kinda just cool. The actors are all great and I absolutely love Tanya Reynolds. Just beautiful. It can drag a little sometimes but not often. Tony Hale is great in it but I'm obsessed with him too I don't make it all the way through shows too often these days and this ride was fun. Now I'm just saying words to fill the ridiculous character amount. Done.

title: A fun and beautifully shot comedy/drama that sometimes loses its way
author: not_an_octopus
body: A group of people trying to social distance in a luxurious Italian Villa find themselves at odds with their own desires. The ensemble cast and farcical comedic styling makes this a fun show to watch. The dramatic elements that are woven in aren't always given proper attention. Not having read the source material I can't speak to what others have said about it not being like the book, however, it is full of resonant themes all people can relate to. Themes like love, friendship, betrayal, jealousy, lust, religious oppression, class differences and wealth inequality, oh and plague.In the course of the series there are many twists and turns, and while the themes are serious, they're handled with darkly comedic flair. Most of the show is fun to watch, but there are a few times where I found myself cringing. Some of the acting feels out of place at times, incongruent and frustratingly one-dimensional. This is not to say there are bad actors in the cast. On the contrary, this is a talented and seasoned group of actors, reminiscent of a theatrical troupe. I wonder if it is more that the direction and choices are not always consistent with the balancing of comedy and drama that the series seems to be reaching for. All in all I enjoyed this, and would watch it again.

title: Too cringe..
author: info-6175
body: I just finished watching the first episode of The Decameron and I'm still trying to wrap my head around it. On one hand, I was hooked from the very beginning - the pacing is fast, the cast is fantastic, and the costumes, set, and cinematography are all top-notch. If you're a fan of shows like Sex Education and Derry Girls, you'll probably like this too.On the other hand, the jokes are a different story. Oh, the jokes. They're just not good. At all. I was expecting a witty and clever take on medieval history, but instead I got babble-humor that fell flat. I was cringing so hard I almost felt embarrassed. And the soundtrack doesn't fit - it's like they thought they could just throw in some 80s pop and call it a day. It's a jarring and awkward attempt to make the show feel more "relatable".Despite all this, I have to admit that I'm hoping it will get better. The cast is great, and I'm curious to see where the story goes. Maybe it'll get better? Maybe they'll dial it back on the babbling and focus on telling a more nuanced and engaging story.But for now, I'm just going to have to suffer through the cringey-babble-humor and hope that the rest of the show is better.

title: So much better than you would expect!
author: fourthfallen-79514
body: Ok, so this show is epic, tragic, funny, heartwarming, and devastating. The actors are all amazing, they all play their parts so convincingly it is a joy to watch. They are all a bit mad and the show has a crazy mania to it, but also very down to earth as this is how it was and how people would act.The story is so addicting, it was hard to not binge every episode once I started. You will have no idea where it is going and be shocked, thrilled and horrified at where it takes you.The writing is fantastic, even though it is set in the dark ages they still speak in a normal fashion so you can relate to the characters. I was so moved by the last two episodes I laughed and cried through most of it. The episode is so heartwarming and satisfying. It could easily end there, or continue on their journey.I highly recommend giving this a watch.

title: Horrible casting and inconsistent story telling
author: AziziOthmanMY
body: The Decameron on Netflix misses the mark in several key areas, leaving viewers underwhelmed and disappointed. The show struggles with pacing, often dragging through scenes that add little to the overall narrative. The characters lack depth and development, making it hard to invest in their stories or care about their outcomes.The adaptation of Boccaccio's classic work feels disjointed, with episodes that seem disconnected and fail to capture the essence of the original tales. Additionally, the production values are subpar, with mediocre set designs and costumes that do little to immerse the audience in the historical setting.Moreover, the show's attempt at modernizing the themes comes off as forced and clumsy, rather than insightful or relevant. The dialogue often feels unnatural and out of place, further detracting from the immersion. Overall, The Decameron on Netflix fails to deliver a compelling or engaging viewing experience, falling short of its potential as a modern adaptation of a literary classic.

title: mixed feelings
author: moonmark-52817
body: It took me awhile to appreciate this as satire. There are almost no laughs. It's best to view this without any attachment. Or emotional investment. Much of what happens makes no sense. There is almost no plot. But there is some character development. The cast is great in spite of the story. But don't get too attached to any character. But that's not a difficult chore as the characters are not likeable. I found this interesting in a disinterested way. I ended up looking at it as a sort of morality play with no real "good guys" or "bad guys". Just characters I really didn't care about. But let me emphasize, the cast is great.

title: Just watch and Enjoy
author: mamec-2
body: Growing up in Europe, I had the Decameron on my reading list in high school, but I remember being quite bored by the sexual stories and not retaining much from the book. Watching this movie reignited my interest, and I plan to read the book again with a more mature perspective. The COVID pandemic has also changed my view on the story, as we now understand what it means to be confined and seek refuge away from the city, much like the characters in this captivating series.I particularly enjoyed the beginning of the series, though I found the ending to be somewhat diluted in its storytelling. When the scriptwriters stayed true to the original Decameron, the content was spicy and engaging.The locations, costumes, and cast were all outstanding. The actors' performances were perfect, making this a memorable series that kept me entertained and up late into the night. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a good series to watch.

title: Really cool lighthearted comedy series
author: carighanamazon
body: I watched this over two evenings, and I got to say going in with 0 expectations it is really *really* fun.In particular Tanya Reynolds knocks it out of the park, nailing facial expressions for her scenes. Though all of the core actors do well, and while the series was clearly not produced with a big budget (and doesn't have to be, owing to its setting being conductive to recycling just a handful of sets) it plays it well, almost selling its interactions as a stage play.It's a really good lighthearted and funny series with its odd serious moment that's then lightened up again. Nothing I'd want 6 seasons of, but for a single 8-episode season it is really enjoyable to watch.

title: This is how we do it now
author: nederlander-37498
body: Apparently you can't do a historical drama, comedy, or satire anymore without blasting pop music and a 21st century outlook shoe-horned into a different century like in My Lady Jane, The Serpent Queen and this series. My gold standard shows are Rome, The Tudors, The Last Viking. They don't feel the need to make history contemporary to us but try with great success to make you feel you're really in another time period with very different values, customs, mores and so on. All three of those series have great writing and don't need to rely on F-bombs to display emotion in the richly-drawn and deep characters.

title: Extremely fun and lighthearted comedy
author: christianekrog
body: This isn't Bridgeton or Game of Thrones. This is an extremely straightforward and enjoyable comedy. I don't know the source material that the piece is apparently based on, nor do I consider myself a snobby Italian Literature critic, but I think that the average person would enjoy this show qutie a bit. The cast is wonderful together and I look forward to this show getting the flowers it deserves.I don't think this show was meant to be serious. I think it was meant to be fun and enjoyable. This show reminds me a lot of the US series Ghosts. I love the ensemble English-centric cast, especially seeing Darby Girls alumni; Saoirse-Monica Jackson.

title: Underrated "period" Comedy - popcorn escapism
author: spasticfreakshow
body: Will this win any awards? No, surely not. I would probably watch anything with Tony Hale, but in this ensemble cast piece, there were tons of fun British actors I did not know previously, but who were marvelously entertaining. It's definitely a parody of a period piece, and it seems highly unlikely that some of the best characters would return for a potential second season/series, but it's a solidly fun watch, if you're not a critic or one who cares about critics. It's a little slapstick, like a Leslie Nielsen film, but with the vibe of The Completely Made-Up Adventures of Dick Turpin or Renegade Nell.

title: Painfully dull
author: grantss
body: Florence, 1348. The Black Death is rampant and the upper class of Florence are fearing for their lives. Some of them hole up in an estate in the country. Romantic intrigues ensue, as do rivalries and animosities. Drama abounds. The Black Death may be the least of their worries...I watched this purely out of curiosity and boredom. I have watched Pier Paolo Pasolini's 1971 adaptation of Giovanni Boccaccio's novel and wasn't impressed, so it wasn't out of wanting to compare the two versions.Turns out that even though I didn't think much of Pasolini's version, this is even worse. It largely consists of dull, empty melodrama and a series of cringy performances. There is some dry humour, especially early on and this is about the only positive. Otherwise it's quite the ordeal to get through.

title: Ignore the low rating
author: mariavespa1
body:
I was sceptical to start watching it, by the reviews on here.I am glad that I did watch it.It's concluded in one season but it is a clever series. And when you think it's a comedy, something dark happens and you are like "wow, I wasn't expecting that!"
The acting is great, the writing is clever and the build up of each character is genius.It has so many messages in it, of hope, of desperation, of dreaming, of love and lost.I suggest you watch it and stick with it.I wish there was a second season because I really want to see something else happening for all the characters of this TV show.

title: Decameron fake
author: colarusso-1
body: First of all, the deception: this series has nothing to do with Bocaccio's Decameron. Just the fact that people took refuge in a castle to escape the Black Death reminds us of the beginning of the medieval masterpiece. After that, the series becomes a soap opera without any historical concerns and with jokes that provoke discreet laughter. And the plot is poorly woven. A girl who was well, had just had a good erotic experience, suddenly becomes stricken with the plague, and her husband is not infected. This is not the first time that Netflix has used this device, using the title of a masterpiece and telling a completely different story. Usher's house was the same thing. In short, an inconsequential nonsense that tries to take a ride on a great literary classic. Nothing more than this.

title: It grows..
author: patrickholsths
body: "A decent watch with potential, but held back by a mediocre script. While the plot and character development could have been stronger, the film manages to entertain in its own way. The visuals and performances are competent, making it worth a look if you're in the mood for something light and don't mind the flaws. It's not groundbreaking or particularly memorable, but it offers enough fun to be enjoyable. If you have some time to spare and aren't looking for anything too serious, this could be a decent choice for a casual viewing. Manage your expectations, and you might enjoy it."... Watchable.

title: Why Even Call It "The Decameron"?
author: mjroberts-07860
body: I think the show would have been better received if they titled it something else and mentioned in the credits that it's very loosely based on "The Decameron." It's like someone read the cliff notes of the book and decided to make the series. I liked the costumes and I don't even mind the modern music and themes thrown in or the historical inaccuracies. Truth be told a historically accurate show would probably be unwatchable. It just doesn't make sense to title it "The Decameron" as the word Decameron comes from a Greek word meaning "ten days" and the series takes place over a few weeks. Again, if it had been titled differently I would have enjoyed it more, but it simply is not a good representation of the source material.

title: Ugh. So wanted to love this but alas I did not.
author: anneanzalone
body: Well, thats 8 hours (probably more like 7 hours due to skipping ahead because I just could not do it anymore) of my life I wont get back. I so badly wanted to love this but it just felt like it could not figure out what type of story it wanted to tell. The funny parts weren't funny enough, the serious parts felt forced. Interesting Storylines felt rushed and a talented cast seemed wasted. A disappointing adaptation that suffers from disorganized storytelling and weak performances. Many themes appear heavy-handed, failing to provide the depth expected. Overall, it does not do justice to the charm and talent of the actors.

title: Laughed out loud so many times
author: Peony_5x5
body: I found this to be an incredibly cohesive, hilarious, and genuinely touching piece of media. It delivers on all fronts- raucous, racy, clever, beautiful and emotional. Just when you think it couldn't deliver more, or in a diverse way, it does just that. I found it to be a true reflection of the wide range of lived experiences.which is why I found myself very connected to the characters in different ways. Ultimately I think it's a remarkable tale of the human experience- especially Panfilo's journey. We are all here for such a little time, so let's make it a good time.I would highly recommend the Decameron for a genuine laugh and a deeper understanding of what it means be on this earth together.

title: Okay...
author: NullUnit
body: Characters are decent. The dry humor is mostly well done. Acting is good. Sets and costumes work.It feels a bit drawn out. Episodes may be too long in general. Humor needs to be a tad quicker to sustain the mood.The largest issues I seem to always have with period pieces now days is that they inject social mindsets of the 21st century into the period being portrayed. It's not overwhelming or overly present in this series, but it does exist. I grow tired of historical pieces written as if everyone has a mindset fitting of 2024 in some respects but not in others. In this series.. misogyny abounds for the most part - as it would have then. However, what would have been condemned in the 1300s is apparently accepted by every character - it's a dichotomy.

title: OFFENSIVE SCAM!!
author: giovannispoladori
body: I'm Italian and i can't accept this Netflix's tendence to bring title from works they didn't even know what are about, creating some orrible series completely uselles and without content. THE REAL DECAMERON is not only a masterpiece of italian literature, but it is a necessary step of the creation of our language, an historical achievement for the growing of our nation and cultural identity. I will explain for people who don't understand the implication of this work for us: the modern Italian language was fixed by a great humanistic writer called Pietro Bembo in 500, who created the first italian grammatic, using important author as an example, in particolar Petrarca and Boccaccio. Considering this serie enjoyable is like launching s**t on immortal people like Dante, Shakespeare, Omero, etc., on the history and culture of a nation.. however, the lack of sensibility is a classic Netflix tendence haha. RIDICOLOUS.

title: Has a sense of humor and is playful
author: stinasimonemp
body: Some shows that seem to be rated 5/10 I seem to like. It goes to show that you can't base your judgment off of a review, but rather make the judgment for yourself. Everyone obviously has a different taste and I happened to enjoy this show a lot. It's funny, witty, has some serious moments but then goes back into making you laugh. It's not meant to be taken seriously, it's meant to entertain you and it did a splendid job. I think you need the right sense of humor for this show. Great job! It was awesome and the production was just as wonderful. I loved every single character. Great job to all of you!

title: Dull start followed by some really nice moments that redeem it
author: megmerriet
body: I almost gave up after episode 2. It had potential but it just wasn't funny... yet was trying to be funny. The actor playing Tindaro was upstaging everyone and was not doing that well with his delivery. His lines are rushed, his delivery often garbled. Meanwhile, the other cast members timing was off and a lot of potentially funny gags fell flat. But something about the setting drew me in. I love the original text and I can relate to being cooped up amidst a pandemic so I really wanted to enjoy this.In later episodes, some heavy stuff happens, and suddenly the show stops TRYING to be a dark comedy and it becomes more naturally funny. There are some really beautiful reflections on life and friendship and the fleeting nature of time. I felt like the show redeemed itself and I watched it to the end. The writing is at times downright sloppy, and the whole project feels rushed and flung together. I worry that Netflix's quality is in decline.

title: It's a pity no attempt was made to be consistent
author: fustbariclation
body: This is nothing like the Decameron. It is, though, a story that's supposed to be set in Florence, at the time of the plague.They've put some effort into costumes, carts, corpses and buboes, which is fine.However, they have put no effort into consistency of language or accent. There are some cod-mediæval phrases and phrasing - they mention the miasma theory of disease - but not that term - but include modern slang expressions too.The accents, all supposedly Florentine, vary from English, to Irish, to American, sometimes in the same person inthe same paragraph.Unfortunately the jokes mainly don't work, because the actors so evidently think themselves to be hugely funny.

title: Entertaining - worth a watch
author: tobiaspmalmberg
body: I think that the 6,4 rating, at the time of writing this review, is a tad too low. It's worth a watch as much of anything else. It's not the greatest I've watched, but certainty not the worst. It's a show that is entertaining and surprisingly full of heart. It obviously doesn't come close to "The Great", which I believe has mastered the genre of satirical black comedy drama, but it's not too far off either.Sure, some of the twists and turns does feel a bit forced, and making the episodes 45 minutes long instead of 30 might not have been the right decision. But again, it's an entertaining show worth everyone's time.

title: Do not skip
author: alex-970-552873
body: At turns hilarious, horrific, and downright daft, this is a series that rewards perseverance. On entering the Decameron's embrace, you are transported to a world that is a delicious mix of costume drama, gothic fairy tale, and horrible history. The direction and cinematography channel Terry Gillingham, and despite a little over dramatic, the acting is on point, once you get into the flow of it. The characters are despicable at first and impossible to like. And yet, as the story progresses, the arcs of each player creates an emotional crescendo that is well worth the journey. As the end credits roll, I was left feeling sorrow for those departed, joy for those who survived, and a little sad that my time with this merry band of players had come to an end. Bravo to all involved.

title: Not Decameron
author: valentinionut
body:
Decameron was written by Bocaccio in the 14th century, and it is a book containing 100 stories about love in that time period. Stories are told in a villa where rich people gathered during the Black Plague to escape infection. Love stories are told by the guests and involve erotic love, tragic love, funny love stories etc. This show has nothing to do with The Decameron book.In the show we see some people gathering in a castle and no stories are told, just quirky events happen to them:
a half-sister takes the place of the rightful sister, a religious young woman dreams of sexual intimacy while her husband is gay and both desire the same man, etc.The scenery is beautiful, and the show is a soft loud comedy that may entertain you.

title: Same as every piece of history touched by Netflix
author: marinavelcu
body: Bad, just bad.Weak humour, politically correct, nothing to do with the actual title. At this point, every single historical series made by Netflix is a parody. I was excited for another historical series, because there hasn't been a good one in a few years (The Tudors, Medici, Borgias, etc) and instead was greeted by the historical version of of a lame comedy. Just change the title at this point, there is no need to draw users in by using the title of famous historical novels, only to disappoint them. I still gave it a chance until the end, hoping it will at least get better. It doesn't. Spare yourself the time and watch something else.

title: Ignore these uptight reviews
author: zombiesmonsters
body: This is hilarious. It's wonderfully stupid and checks all the marks. I stg there are too many people obsessed with looking smart and give bad reviews because they're too dumb to loosen up.Characters are really well written and I've thoroughly enjoyed how the silliness panned out. Yadda yadda yadda. Idc about writing reviews but I felt I had to for this one and the limit is annoyingly long.Anyway, the little plot twist is also stupidly funny. I have a cat, Merlin, and he marks despite being fixed, can anyone help me with that?Anyway, this show is still new, let's hope my 10 counteracts the pseudo-intellectuals even if it is only by a tiny fraction.

title: 14th Century Plague-themed Noble party
author: balthesaur
body: 'The Decameron' follows a villa outside of Florence, Italy, in which a group of unlikely guests come together to get away from the plague, which has decimated the Italian city, and to get in the good graces of the manor lord. With Doctor Dioneo (Amar Chadha-Patel), Panfilio Karan Gill) and his wife, Neifile (Lou Gala), Pampinea (Zosia Mamet) and her handmaiden, Misia (Saoirse-Monica Jackson), Tindaro (Douggie McMeekin), Filomena (Jessica Plummer) and her handmaiden / would be assailant, Licisca (Tanya Reynolds), they attempt to hold out and not die by the disease or each other.This show is cast as a comedy, and in truth, it does have some funny moments, but it is more a drama. The casting is well done and decently convincing, the direction is a bit convoluted towards the end, and the ending is rather unsatisfying, but overall a fascinating watch! Each character has some well-developed growth, which is somewhat uncommon in these short mini-series entries.Worth a watch!

title: What the Hell were they thinking?
author: hodorgrrm
body: This show is a puzzlement. It's not funny. It's not dramatic. There are some moments of uncomfortable 'humor' that fall flat. The whole thing falls flat. Some moments of acting can be appreciated, but really - it's a mystery why this was made, how it was so bad for so long without someone on the production or in the studios involved questioning what exactly what they were making. In a way, it's a case study in how such poor quality it made and aired in this day and time. Have standards fallen so low that people think this is funny or well written? The networks must be truly desperate for content for this to see the light of day. Let it be forgotten.

title: Come laugh at this wacky character
author: Returnee
body: I saw this show in my recommended section and decided to give it a try. Please note that I have only watched episode 1 of this show and am not planning to watch any more. It may get better or worse, on which I can't comment, so treat this as purely a review for the first episode.First, let me say that if you are the sort of person who needs historical accuracy, then this is definitely not the show for you, as it is sort of all over the place. However, in my opinion, it also isn't the sort of show that requires it, and I can at least more than forgive it in that aspect.Now for something I cannot forgive, which is the humor, the very core around what such a show revolves. I heard some people note that this is satire and comments on human nature, following a cast of characters through their development. But from what I have seen, the entirety of the humor stems from "Look at this wacky character doing something wacky." The characters are one-dimensional, serving no other purpose but comic relief (impressive to do this not only with one character but seemingly with everyone). The humor ranges from high-brow and thoughtful jokes such as, "look at the funny facial expressions she is making" all the way to, "look at this adult character acting like a spoiled little kid." From what I have seen, I hence expect nothing more from the show. The writing ranges from barely passable to bad, with the acting-or let's rather call it overacting in many cases-being generally off-putting. I do not blame the actors for this, as this appears much more to be a decision from the show itself.So, all in all, I would say this show does not deserve a watch, unless maybe you are getting stoned and just want something to run in the background that you don't have to think too hard about.

title: Blending High and Low Elements
author: drlex-15751
body: "The Decameron," created by Kathleen Jordan and premiering on Netflix in August 2024, is an adaptation of the classic medieval work by Giovanni Boccaccio. The series follows a group of nobles and their servants who gather at a country villa during the height of the "Black Death" in 1348 Italy.One of the series' strengths lies in its ability to blend high and low, spiritual and physical, tragic and comic elements. The show's opening scenes, which depict the streets of Florence in panic, set the tone for the rest of the series. The characters, including the vain Viscountess Pampinea, the selfish Felomena, and the hypochondriac Tindaro, are complex and multi-faceted, showcasing the human condition during a time of great suffering.The series also explores the theme of human nature in the face of death and disease. The characters' secrets and hidden agendas add depth to the narrative, showing how even in the midst of tragedy, people continue to pursue their own desires and ambitions.The show's visuals are particularly noteworthy, with the use of animated rats and the song "Ave Maria" creating a unique and thought-provoking atmosphere. The series also manages to maintain the spirit of Boccaccio's original work, while updating it for a modern audience.However, the series does have its shortcomings. The pacing can be uneven, with some episodes feeling rushed while others drag on. Additionally, the show's use of modern language and elements, such as swearing and diverse characters, may not appeal to all viewers.Overall, "The Decameron" is a compelling adaptation that successfully blends the classic with the contemporary. The series' exploration of human nature, complex characters, and unique visual style make it a must-watch for fans of historical dramas and those interested in the human condition.Rating: 7 out of 10.

title: So Much Fun!
author: alm04
body: I am glad to see that the ratings have gone up since I started watching because I honestly did not understand the hate. I agree with other reviewers who refer to this as Shakespearean fun. It's like a satirical version of Midsummer Night's Dream. I've watched this attentively, then I've put it on in the background. It's so hilarious!!If you are a literature, theatre, or history enthusiast, I think you will thoroughly enjoy this. I imagine the actors were having the best time while filming this. I hope there is a second season and that Netflix will continue to create content for the aforementioned literature, theatre, and history enthusiasts!

title: utter disappointment
author: jeanbonblanc
body: This is apparently a highly anticipated show and in a way I can see why. It could have been good but instead it is not just a disappointment but bad. The casting is terrible. This is supposed to take place in medieval Florence and yet it opens with a bunch of British actresses blabbering on. This could still have worked if the plot made any sense and if the acting had been decent (neither is the case here). You have a city in the middle of the plague with people living a normal life amongst the dead... the show then moves on to some villa in the countryside and somehow it becomes even worse. You can see this was supposed to be a comedy on a dark subject. Instead you have a show which is a joke. So don't waste your time and go watch something else (Tokyo Swindlers for example is excellent)

title: a Decent Dreamworks show, better than the Megamind show
author: kismetslayer
body: I don't care if these people call it a paw patrol ripoff, it's decent, it's better than the Megamind showthat show is.....just teamwork after all.Why do you guys call it a Paw Patrol ripoff?I mean shows like "Top Wing" gets called as a Paw Patrol ripoff, just because it's made with a "Rescue Vehicle Team" feel to itand yes the whole thing before their rescues is similar to paw patrol. Love the themes of working together and figuring out how to positively solve problems!!! The voices of the characters are so cute!!! Especially love Sonnie!!! So fun how he goes from a motorcycle to a helicopter. Highly recommend this wonderful new show!! Great job Netflix!! Hope they make many more episodes!!! author: ktsybergolsen
body:
Wow just wow! This show is everything you could want and more for a preschool show. It is safe to say we're definitely hooked!!
